title: Pulmonary Vein Stenosis and Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence: A Comparison of Clinical Outcomes of Radiofrequency Ablation versus Cryoablation
TyG-BRI, frailty, and all-cause mortality in older adults with atrial fibrillation without diabetes: a two-cohort study
summary: Metabolic dysregulation and frailty are both associated with adverse outcomes in atrial fibrillation (AF), but their combined associations with mortality among older adults with AF remain unclear. We investigated the independent and joint associations of the triglyceride-glucose–body roundness index (TyG-BRI) and frailty status with all-cause mortality in older adults with AF without diabetes. We analysed data from two prospective cohorts: the UK Biobank (n = 2573) and a community-based AF cohort from Jiangdu, China (n = 803). Participants were categorized according to TyG-BRI tertiles and frailty status (robust vs. non-robust). Multivariable Cox regression, restricted cubic spline analyses, and predictive performance analyses were performed. During follow-up, 969 and 179 deaths occurred in the UK Biobank and Jiangdu cohorts, respectively. TyG-BRI showed significant nonlinear associations with all-cause mortality in both cohorts. In categorical analyses, only high TyG-BRI was significantly associated with increased mortality in the UK Biobank, whereas both low and high TyG-BRI were associated with increased mortality in the Jiangdu cohort. Frailty status was consistently associated with increased mortality risk across populations. Joint analyses demonstrated that non-robust participants with abnormal TyG-BRI levels had the highest mortality risk. The incremental predictive performance of the combined assessment was modest and varied between cohorts. Among older adults with AF without diabetes, TyG-BRI and frailty status were associated with all-cause mortality, and their joint assessment identified subgroups with different levels of mortality risk. These findings suggest that TyG-BRI and frailty may provide complementary prognostic information in this population. What is already known on this topic? Metabolic dysregulation and frailty are both associated with adverse outcomes in older adults with atrial fibrillation, but their combined impact on mortality risk remains unclear. What this study adds? In two independent cohorts from the UK and China, TyG-BRI showed a nonlinear association with all-cause mortality, and joint assessment of TyG-BRI and frailty identified high-risk subgroups. How this study might affect research, practice or policy? These findings support further evaluation of combined metabolic and frailty assessment for mortality risk stratification in older adults with AF without diabetes.

AI.tldr: 在无糖尿病的老年房颤患者中，TyG-BRI与衰弱状态均与全因死亡相关，联合评估可识别不同死亡风险亚组。
AI.motivation: 代谢失调和衰弱均与房颤不良结局相关，但两者联合对无糖尿病老年房颤患者死亡风险的关联尚不明确，既往证据存在缺口。
AI.method: 分析两个前瞻性队列：英国生物银行（n=2573）和中国江都社区房颤队列（n=803）。按TyG-BRI三分位和衰弱状态（健壮 vs. 非健壮）分组。采用多变量Cox回归、限制性立方样条和预测性能分析，终点为全因死亡。
AI.result: 随访期间英国生物银行和江都队列分别发生969例和179例死亡。TyG-BRI与全因死亡呈显著非线性关联。分类分析中，英国生物银行仅高TyG-BRI与死亡增加显著相关，江都队列低和高TyG-BRI均与死亡增加相关。衰弱状态在两个人群中均与死亡风险增加相关。联合分析显示，非健壮且TyG-BRI异常者死亡风险最高。联合评估的增量预测性能有限且两队列间存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 在无糖尿病的老年房颤患者中，TyG-BRI和衰弱状态与全因死亡相关，联合评估可识别不同死亡风险亚组，提示两者可能提供互补的预后信息。研究支持进一步评估代谢与衰弱联合评估用于该人群死亡风险分层，但预测性能有限且需外部验证。

title: A Fast and Generalizable Deep Neural Network for the Detection of Atrial Fibrillation
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AFib) is the most prevalent sustained cardiac arrhythmia, yet most deep learning detectors are validated on a single cohort and few report uncertainty. We developed a compact 14M-parameter convolutional neural network for binary AFib classification from 10 s, 12-lead ECG at 500 Hz, trained exclusively on the HDXML dataset (67,432 ECGs; 9628 AFib) with on-the-fly augmentation for noise, drift and missing channels. Using one unchanged checkpoint, we evaluated six independently sourced public cohorts totaling over 1.25 million recordings, including MIMIC-IV critical care and two ambulatory Holter cohorts. All metrics are reported with 95% confidence intervals from a cluster bootstrap at the patient, recording or subject levels. ROC–AUC exceeded 0.95 in every cohort, from 0.960 (95% CI 0.956–0.963) on CODE-15 to 0.999 (0.998–0.999) on SPH, including 0.966 (0.965–0.967) on MIMIC-IV with 75.3% sensitivity and 97.7% specificity, 0.963 (0.929–0.987) on CPSC 2021 and 0.995 (0.988–0.999) on MIT-BIH. Performance was stable under progressive lead masking without retraining, and median inference took 110 ms per segment on a server-class CPU without a GPU. A compact network trained on one curated source can therefore generalize across hospitals, countries and recording hardware. This study is retrospective; prospective validation is required before clinical use.

AI.tldr: 一个14M参数的CNN仅用HDXML数据集训练，在六个外部队列（超125万份心电图）中检测房颤的ROC-AUC均超过0.95，且无需GPU推理仅需110毫秒。
AI.motivation: 房颤是最常见的持续性心律失常，但现有深度学习检测器大多仅在单一队列中验证，且很少报告不确定性，限制了其泛化性和临床可信度。
AI.method: 开发一个紧凑的14M参数卷积神经网络，输入为10秒、12导联、500Hz的心电图，进行二分类房颤检测。仅使用HDXML数据集（67,432份心电图，其中9,628份房颤）训练，并采用噪声、漂移和缺失通道的在线增强。使用同一检查点，在六个独立来源的公共队列（总计超过125万份记录）上评估，包括MIMIC-IV重症监护和两个动态Holter队列。所有指标均通过患者、记录或受试者水平的聚类自助法报告95%置信区间。
AI.result: 所有队列的ROC-AUC均超过0.95：CODE-15为0.960（95% CI 0.956–0.963），SPH为0.999（0.998–0.999），MIMIC-IV为0.966（0.965–0.967）伴75.3%敏感性和97.7%特异性，CPSC 2021为0.963（0.929–0.987），MIT-BIH为0.995（0.988–0.999）。在渐进导联掩蔽下性能稳定且无需重新训练，服务器级CPU上每段中位推理时间110毫秒（无GPU）。
AI.conclusion: 一个在单一精选数据源上训练的紧凑网络能够跨医院、国家和记录硬件泛化，展示了良好的外部有效性。但本研究为回顾性，临床使用前需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh: 背景：心房颤动（AFib）是最常见的持续性心律失常，然而大多数深度学习检测器仅在单一队列中进行验证，且很少报告不确定性。我们开发了一个紧凑的14M参数卷积神经网络，用于基于10秒、12导联、500 Hz心电图进行二分类AFib检测，该网络仅在HDXML数据集（67,432份心电图；9628份AFib）上进行训练，并采用动态增强处理噪声、漂移和缺失导联。方法：使用一个未更改的检查点，我们评估了六个独立来源的公共队列，总计超过125万份记录，包括MIMIC-IV重症监护和两个动态Holter队列。所有指标均报告了来自患者、记录或受试者水平聚类bootstrap的95%置信区间。结果：ROC–AUC在每个队列中均超过0.95，从CODE-15的0.960（95% CI 0.956–0.963）到SPH的0.999（0.998–0.999），包括MIMIC-IV的0.966（0.965–0.967），灵敏度为75.3%，特异度为97.7%，CPSC 2021的0.963（0.929–0.987）和MIT-BIH的0.995（0.988–0.999）。在无需重新训练的情况下，性能在渐进式导联掩蔽下保持稳定，在无GPU的服务器级CPU上，每段中位推理时间为110毫秒。结论：因此，在一个精选来源上训练的紧凑网络可以跨医院、国家和记录硬件进行泛化。本研究为回顾性研究；在临床使用前需要进行前瞻性验证。

title: CO-50 | LEFT ATRIAL APPENDAGE OCCLUSION IN PATIENTS WITH ATRIAL FIBRILLATION AND BLEEDING DISORDERS: A SINGLE-CENTER EXPERIENCE
summary: Introduction. Data about the management of atrial fibrillation (AF) in patients with hemophilia and other bleeding disorders (BD) are limited. The reliability of stroke risk scores (i.e. CHA2DS2VASc), used in the general population for treatment choices, and long-term safety of anticoagulation, as well the need for concomitant hemostatic prophylaxis, remain unknown. Left atrial appendage occlusion (LAAO) has been suggested as an alternative to anticoagulation in patients with high bleeding risk, few cases being reported even in BD.Methods. Retrospective review of patients with BD and AF who underwent LAAO at the University Hospital of Parma.Results. Eight patients were identified, 6 males and 2 females, aged 64-80 yrs (Table). Mean CHA2DS2VASc was 4 (range 2-5). Two men had mild factor VII deficiency, both on aspirin (ASA) 100 mg/d because of history of myocardial revascularization due to diffuse coronary artery disease. Combined antiplatelet-anticoagulation treatment was considered in both patients after AF diagnosis, due to very high cardiovascular and stroke risk; the concomitant bleeding risk led to consider LAAO. Three elderly men with hemophilia A (2 severe, 1 moderate) on tertiary prophylaxis were reluctant to any long-term antithrombotic treatment. A moderate hemophilia B patient treated on demand developed AF in the setting of severe chronic heart failure. The two female patients had a type 2A von Willebrand disease (VWF:RCo 10%) and an acquired von Willebrand syndrome (AVWS, VWF:RCo 5%; concomitant detection of monoclonal gammopathy of uncertain significance). In all patients but one the Amplatzer plug was successfully implanted; heparinization was managed with specific replacement treatment, achieving factor levels ≥80% during and up to 24h after the procedure. One patient experienced mild pericardial effusion. No thromboembolic events were observed. Overall, bleeding episodes occurred In 5/8 cases. Patients with mild FVII deficiencies received double antiplatelet treatment for 3-6 months reporting mild mucocutaneous bleeding, then remained on ASA. Single antiplatelet treatment and FVIII personalized prophylaxis (FVIII trough >5-10%) were used in the 3 hemophiliacs, one withdrew clopidogrel after 2 months due to severe epistaxis and joint bleeds. No relevant bleeding occurred in the old men on anticoagulation, made possible by sustained prophylaxis with extended half-life FIX, nor in the two women with VWF abnormalities on ASA (the AVWS patient received VWF-FVIII concentrate prophylaxis for 4 months).Conclusions. Adequate factor levels to allow safe antithrombotic treatments in BD patients remain uncertain. LAAO, when performed at experienced facilities, is a safe alternative to anticoagulation in BD with AF-related stroke risk.

AI.tldr: 单中心回顾性研究显示，8例合并出血性疾病的房颤患者行左心耳封堵术，无血栓栓塞事件，5例发生出血事件但多为轻度，提示LAAO在高出血风险患者中安全可行。
AI.motivation: 合并血友病等出血性疾病的房颤患者抗凝管理证据有限，卒中风险评分（如CHA2DS2VASc）的可靠性及抗凝长期安全性未知，左心耳封堵（LAAO）作为高出血风险患者的替代方案仅有个案报道。
AI.method: 回顾性分析帕尔马大学医院合并出血性疾病并接受LAAO的房颤患者，共8例（6男2女，年龄64-80岁），平均CHA2DS2VASc评分4分（范围2-5）。干预为LAAO，围术期采用针对性凝血因子替代治疗维持因子水平≥80%。主要终点为手术成功及安全性（血栓栓塞和出血事件），统计方法为描述性分析。
AI.result: 8例中7例成功植入Amplatzer封堵器，1例出现轻度心包积液。无血栓栓塞事件。总体出血事件5/8例：2例轻度FVII缺乏者术后双联抗血小板3-6个月出现轻度皮肤黏膜出血，后维持阿司匹林；3例血友病患者中1例因严重鼻出血和关节出血于2个月停用氯吡格雷；接受延长半衰期FIX预防的老年患者及接受阿司匹林的VWF异常女性患者均无相关出血。
AI.conclusion: 在经验丰富的中心，LAAO是合并出血性疾病房颤患者预防卒中安全的抗凝替代方案，但允许安全抗血栓治疗的理想凝血因子水平仍不明确。研究为小样本回顾性设计，结论需更大规模研究验证。

summary_zh:
引言。关于血友病及其他出血性疾病（BD）患者心房颤动（AF）管理的数据有限。用于一般人群治疗选择的卒中风险评分（即CHA2DS2VASc）的可靠性、抗凝治疗的长期安全性以及伴随止血预防的必要性仍未知。左心耳封堵（LAAO）已被建议作为高出血风险患者抗凝治疗的替代方案，即使在BD中也有少数病例报道。

方法。对在帕尔马大学医院接受LAAO的BD合并AF患者进行回顾性审查。

结果。共识别出8例患者，6男2女，年龄64-80岁（表）。平均CHA2DS2VASc为4（范围2-5）。两名男性患有轻度因子VII缺乏症，均因弥漫性冠状动脉疾病行心肌血运重建史而服用阿司匹林（ASA）100 mg/d。两例患者在AF诊断后因心血管和卒中风险极高而考虑联合抗血小板-抗凝治疗；伴随的出血风险导致考虑LAAO。三名老年男性血友病A患者（2例重型，1例中型）接受三级预防，不愿接受任何长期抗血栓治疗。一名按需治疗的中型血友病B患者在严重慢性心力衰竭背景下发生AF。两名女性患者分别患有2A型血管性血友病（VWF:RCo 10%）和获得性血管性血友病综合征（AVWS，VWF:RCo 5%；同时检测到意义未明的单克隆丙种球蛋白病）。除一例外，所有患者均成功植入Amplatzer封堵器；肝素化通过特定替代治疗管理，在手术期间及术后24小时内达到因子水平≥80%。一例患者出现轻度心包积液。未观察到血栓栓塞事件。总体而言，5/8例发生出血事件。轻度FVII缺乏症患者接受双联抗血小板治疗3-6个月，报告轻度皮肤黏膜出血，随后继续服用ASA。3名血友病患者使用单联抗血小板治疗和FVIII个体化预防（FVIII谷浓度>5-10%），其中一例因严重鼻出血和关节出血在2个月后停用氯吡格雷。接受抗凝治疗的老年男性通过延长半衰期FIX的持续预防使抗凝成为可能，未发生相关出血；两名VWF异常的女性服用ASA也未发生相关出血（AVWS患者接受VWF-FVIII浓缩物预防4个月）。

结论。在BD患者中，允许安全抗血栓治疗的足够因子水平仍不确定。在经验丰富的机构进行LAAO时，对于伴有AF相关卒中风险的BD患者，是抗凝治疗的安全替代方案。

title: Cardiac amyloidosis: what every interventional cardiologist should know.
summary: Cardiac amyloidosis (CA) is increasingly encountered by interventional cardiologists during the evaluation of chest pain, myocardial injury, coronary artery disease, atrial arrhythmias, and aortic stenosis. Its recognition can be challenging because amyloid cardiomyopathy often coexists with common coronary, valvular, and arrhythmic conditions. A key diagnostic clue is discordance: the apparent coronary, valvular, or hemodynamic abnormality does not fully explain the patient's symptoms, myocardial phenotype, low-flow physiology, or persistent high-sensitivity cardiac troponin elevation. This review focuses on clinical situations in which interventional cardiologists should suspect CA. We discuss myocardial ischemia and coronary microvascular dysfunction caused by intramural vascular amyloid deposition, extravascular compression, and impaired vasodilator reserve; atrial arrhythmias and catheter ablation; the frequent coexistence of transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis (ATTR-CM) with aortic stenosis in patients undergoing transcatheter aortic valve implantation; and the complementary roles of echocardiography, cardiac computed tomography, cardiovascular magnetic resonance, bone-avid tracer scintigraphy, and invasive hemodynamic assessment. We also propose a practical cath-lab approach that integrates readily available clinical information, recognizes persistent or disproportionate myocardial injury as a diagnostic red flag, promptly distinguishes light-chain from ATTR amyloidosis, and preserves appropriate treatment of coexisting coronary or valvular disease. For the interventional cardiologist, the central principle is simple: when the lesion does not fully explain the patient, look beyond the lesion.

AI.tldr: 综述指出介入心脏病医生在评估胸痛、冠脉病、房颤、主动脉瓣狭窄时应警惕心脏淀粉样变，当病变不能完全解释症状时需进一步排查。
AI.motivation: 心脏淀粉样变常与冠心病、瓣膜病和心律失常共存，介入医生在导管室中易漏诊；既往证据多来自心衰专科，缺乏面向介入场景的识别路径。
AI.method: 叙述性综述，无样本量与统计方法；总结介入医生应怀疑CA的临床情境：心肌缺血与冠脉微血管功能障碍、房颤与导管消融、ATTR-CM与主动脉瓣狭窄行TAVI、多模态影像与侵入性血流动力学评估，并提出导管室实用流程。
AI.result: 摘要未报告原始研究数据或效应量；提出诊断线索为“不一致性”：冠脉、瓣膜或血流动力学异常不能完全解释症状、心肌表型、低血流生理或持续hs-cTn升高；强调区分轻链型与ATTR型并兼顾冠脉/瓣膜病治疗。
AI.conclusion: 介入医生应遵循“当病变不能完全解释患者时，要超越病变本身”的原则，对疑似CA者及时筛查分型；本文为专家综述，建议尚需前瞻性研究验证。

title: Lyme Carditis Beyond Atrioventricular Block: Cardiac Arrest and Transient Atrial Fibrillation With Preserved Atrioventricular Conduction.
summary: Lyme disease may involve the heart during early dissemination and most commonly produces atrioventricular (AV) conduction abnormalities. PR interval prolongation, therefore, frequently guides clinical suspicion and management. We describe a previously healthy man who presented with seizure-like activity, aborted cardiac arrest, transient atrial fibrillation, and cardiac magnetic resonance findings consistent with acute myocarditis, although AV conduction remained normal. Serologic testing subsequently confirmed Lyme carditis. The patient recovered completely with oral doxycycline. This case illustrates that electrical instability may occur despite preserved PR intervals and reinforces the need for suspicion in patients with compatible systemic features.

title: Serial Artificial Intelligence ECG-Derived Atrial Fibrillation Probability and Recurrence Risk After Pulsed Field Ablation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pulsed field ablation is now widely used for atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation, but atrial tachyarrhythmia recurrence remains common and postablation risk tools are limited. We assessed whether a validated sinus‑rhythm artificial intelligence- enabled ECG AF probability score, and its early postablation change, predicts recurrence after pulsed field ablation.

METHODS: We studied consecutive patients undergoing index pulsed field ablation across 3 Mayo Clinic sites (February 2024-March 2025) with ≥1 sinus‑rhythm ECG within 180 days preprocedure. Baseline artificial intelligence-enabled ECG AF score (range 0-1) was the mean across baseline ECGs. Recovery indices (RI30/60/90), defined as mean postprocedure artificial intelligence-enabled ECG score within days 1-30/60/90 minus baseline, predicted post‑blanking recurrence using corresponding 30‑, 60‑, and 90‑day blanking windows. The primary outcome was time to first documented AF/atrial flutter/atrial tachycardia episode >30 seconds, ascertained via clinic ECGs, ambulatory monitoring, and device interrogations. Cox regression adjusted for prespecified clinical and echocardiographic covariates assessed associations; Harrell C‑statistic quantified discrimination.

RESULTS: Among 1052 patients (67±10 years; 33% women), median baseline score was 0.35; 320 (30%) recurred over 188 days. Higher baseline score independently predicted recurrence (hazard ratio per 0.1 increase, 1.08 [95% CI, 1.03-1.14]). Scores rose on day 0 after ablation, then declined over subsequent weeks, with persistently higher, less‑improving trajectories among patients who recurred (time×recurrence interaction P<0.001). Day 0 score was not independently associated with recurrence after adjustment. Attenuated early recovery (higher recovery index) was independently associated with recurrence, most robustly for RI-90 (hazard ratio per 0.1 increase, 1.15 [95% CI, 1.07-1.24]), and improved discrimination beyond baseline and covariates (C‑statistic, 0.63-0.67; ΔC=0.04). Findings were consistent in a historical thermal ablation cohort.

CONCLUSIONS: Baseline and early postablation dynamics of a sinus‑rhythm artificial intelligence-enabled ECG AF probability score are associated with pulsed field ablation recurrence and may aid multivariable risk stratification; prospective validation is warranted.

title: Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists and the Risk of Stroke in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation and Type 2 Diabetes: A Danish Nationwide Cohort Study
Improving Long-Term Outcomes in Atrial Fibrillation: Temporal Decline in Stroke and Dementia Risk Among Danish Patients – A Danish Nationwide Registry-Based Study, 1995–2025
Impact of differences in kidney function estimation by creatinine compared to cystatin C on clinical outcomes in patients with atrial fibrillation.
summary:
AIMS: Differences between cystatin C-based and creatinine-based glomerular filtration rate estimations (eGFRdiff) have been associated with adverse outcomes. We aimed to investigate the prevalence of eGFRdiff and its association with clinical outcomes and brain lesions in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF).

METHODS AND RESULTS: We analysed 3804 patients with AF enrolled in two prospective, multicentre cohort studies. The eGFRdiff was calculated by 'cystatin C-based eGFR-creatinine-based eGFR'. Patients were stratified into three groups: eGFRdiff >10, -10 to 10, and <-10 mL/min/1.73 m². Associations with high-sensitivity troponin T (hs-TnT), NT-proBNP, major adverse cardiovascular (CV) events (stroke/systemic embolism, myocardial infarction and CV death), first heart failure (HF) hospitalization, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-detected brain lesions were assessed. The mean age was 71 years, 28% were female, and 49% had paroxysmal AF. An eGFRdiff of >10, -10 to 10, and <-10 mL/min/1.73 m2 was present in 17.7%, 71.7%, and 10.6% of the patients, respectively. Incidence rates per 100 patient-years increased across these groups for major CV events (MACEs: 1.7, 3.9, 6.8) and HF hospitalization (1.2, 3.5, 6.1). Similarly, the prevalence of MRI-detected brain infarcts (28%, 39%, 42%) and moderate-to-severe white matter hyperintensities (38%, 55%, 63%) increased with greater eGFRdiff. The levels of hs-TnT and NT-proBNP were inversely correlated with eGFRdiff. In multivariable-adjusted linear models, lower eGFRdiff was associated with MACE (P = 0.006) and HF hospitalization (P = 0.015).

CONCLUSION: A substantial proportion of patients with AF exhibit clinically relevant eGFRdiff. More negative eGFR difference was associated with elevated cardiac biomarkers, greater burden of ischaemic brain lesions, and increased risk of CV events and HF hospitalization.

title: Phenotypic clustering of atrial fibrillation patients using latent class analysis and its potential utility for ablation strategy: insights from the DIRECT-Extend and EARNEST-PVI studies.
summary:
AIMS: AF is a heterogeneous syndrome. We aimed to assess whether latent class analysis (LCA) can identify phenotypes that stratify prognosis and predict differential responses to catheter ablation strategies.

METHODS AND RESULTS: We first developed an LCA-based phenotyping model using the DIRECT-Extend registry (N = 7512), a pooled AF cohort of patients receiving anticoagulation therapy. Patients with echocardiographic data (N = 2741) were classified into latent clusters based on 16 clinical, laboratory, and echocardiographic variables. This phenotypic classification was then applied to the randomized Effect of Extensive Ablation on Recurrence in Patients with Persistent AF Treated with Pulmonary Vein Isolation (EARNEST-PVI) trial to evaluate whether the effectiveness of ablation strategies-pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) alone vs. PVI plus extensive ablation (PVI-plus)-varied across phenotypes. In the DIRECT-Extend registry, three phenotypes were identified: Phenotype 1 (N = 1565; 'low comorbidity'), Phenotype 2 (N = 981; 'cardiomyopathy & chronic kidney disease'), and Phenotype 3 (N = 195; 'inflammatory-enriched AF'). Over a median of 600 days, the primary endpoint-a composite of all-cause death, acute myocardial infarction, any stroke, and major bleeding differed across phenotypes (log-rank P < 0.001). In EARNEST-PVI, patients were stratified into Phenotype 1 (N = 328), Phenotype 2 (N = 139), and Phenotype 3 (N = 30) according to the classification model. AF recurrence was significantly lower in the PVI-plus group compared to the PVI-alone group in Phenotype 1 (log-rank P = 0.013), whereas there was no significant difference in Phenotypes 2 and 3.

CONCLUSION: LCA identified distinct AF phenotypes associated with prognoses. These phenotypes may also provide insights into heterogeneity in response to ablation strategies. This phenotyping approach may support risk stratification and individualized AF management.

AI.tldr: 潜在类别分析在房颤患者中识别出三种表型，预后不同，且仅低合并症表型从PVI+广泛消融中获益。
AI.motivation: 房颤是异质性综合征，既往缺乏基于多维度变量的表型分类来指导消融策略选择，需探索能否用潜在类别分析识别预后分层及对消融策略反应不同的表型。
AI.method: 研究分两步：首先用DIRECT-Extend注册队列（N=7512，接受抗凝治疗的房颤患者）中2741例有超声心动图数据者，基于16项临床、实验室和超声变量建立潜在类别分析表型模型；再将分类模型应用于EARNEST-PVI随机试验，比较PVI alone与PVI-plus（广泛消融）在不同表型中的疗效差异。主要终点为全因死亡、急性心肌梗死、任何卒中及大出血的复合终点（DIRECT-Extend）和房颤复发（EARNEST-PVI）。统计方法包括log-rank检验。
AI.result: DIRECT-Extend中识别出3种表型：表型1（N=1565，低合并症）、表型2（N=981，心肌病与慢性肾脏病）、表型3（N=195，炎症富集型房颤）。中位随访600天，主要复合终点在各表型间差异显著（log-rank P<0.001）。EARNEST-PVI中按模型分为表型1（N=328）、表型2（N=139）、表型3（N=30）；表型1中PVI-plus组房颤复发显著低于PVI alone组（log-rank P=0.013），表型2和3中两种策略无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 潜在类别分析识别出与预后相关的不同房颤表型，并提示消融策略反应存在异质性：仅低合并症表型可能从PVI+广泛消融中获益。该表型分类有助于风险分层和个体化房颤管理，但需外部验证，且EARNEST-PVI中部分表型样本量较小。

summary_zh:
目的：AF是一种异质性综合征。我们旨在评估潜在类别分析（LCA）能否识别出可对预后进行分层并预测对导管消融策略差异反应的临床表型。

方法与结果：我们首先使用DIRECT-Extend注册研究（N = 7512）开发了一个基于LCA的表型分型模型，该研究是一个接受抗凝治疗的AF患者的汇总队列。具有超声心动图数据的患者（N = 2741）根据16项临床、实验室和超声心动图变量被分类为潜在类别。随后，该表型分类被应用于随机对照的Effect of Extensive Ablation on Recurrence in Patients with Persistent AF Treated with Pulmonary Vein Isolation（EARNEST-PVI）试验，以评估消融策略——单纯肺静脉隔离（PVI）与PVI加广泛消融（PVI-plus）——的有效性是否因表型而异。在DIRECT-Extend注册研究中，识别出三种表型：表型1（N = 1565；'低合并症'）、表型2（N = 981；'心肌病与慢性肾脏病'）和表型3（N = 195；'炎症富集型AF'）。在中位600天的随访中，主要终点——全因死亡、急性心肌梗死、任何卒中和重大出血的复合终点——在不同表型间存在差异（log-rank P < 0.001）。在EARNEST-PVI中，根据分类模型，患者被分层为表型1（N = 328）、表型2（N = 139）和表型3（N = 30）。在表型1中，PVI-plus组的AF复发率显著低于单纯PVI组（log-rank P = 0.013），而在表型2和表型3中无显著差异。

结论：LCA识别出了与预后相关的不同AF表型。这些表型还可能为消融策略反应的异质性提供见解。这种表型分型方法可能支持风险分层和个体化AF管理。

title: Improved patient value after implementing same day discharge for patients undergoing pulmonary vein isolation.
authors: Mileen R D van de Kar
summary:
AIMS: Pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) is an effective intervention to treat atrial fibrillation, which is increasingly prevalent. Same-day discharge (SDD) is a strategic approach to limit procedure-related costs. This study aimed to compare healthcare utilization, costs, and clinical outcomes before and after implementation of an SDD protocol.

METHODS AND RESULTS: This retrospective study included 2987 patients undergoing PVI between 1 January 2016 and 1 April 2021. Baseline characteristics, pre-, peri-, and post-procedure healthcare utilization and clinical outcomes were compared before (cohort A; n = 1379) and after (Cohort B; n = 1608) implementation of the SDD protocol using bivariate and multivariate analyses. show that cohort B vs. cohort A had lower all-cause 90-day mortality (0% vs. 0.3%, P = 0.031), no differences in re-ablation < 1 year (P = 0.286), as well as in complications: bleedings (P = 0.177), tamponade < 30 days (P = 0.157), phrenic nerve injury (P = 0.984), thromboembolic complication < 72 h (P = 0.212), or vascular complications (P = 0.290). In terms of healthcare utilization and costs, cohort B had significantly less peri-procedure hospital admission costs (€721.52 vs. €1011.78, P < 0.001) and less total peri- and post-procedure costs (€840.37 vs. €1152.94, P < 0.001). Adjusted for all baseline characteristics, the post-implementation cohort showed on average €315 lower total costs per patient.

CONCLUSION: The implementation of the SDD protocol was associated with comparable complication rates while significantly reducing both peri- and post-procedure healthcare utilization and costs, thereby enhancing patient value. This indicates a potential margin for further cost reductions and increased efficiency.

AI.tldr: 实施肺静脉隔离当日出院方案后，患者90天全因死亡率更低、并发症无差异，且围术期及术后总费用显著降低，每例平均节省315欧元。
AI.motivation: 肺静脉隔离是治疗房颤的有效手段，但手术相关费用较高。当日出院策略可限制费用，但其对医疗资源利用、费用及临床结局的影响尚需真实世界证据。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，纳入2016年1月1日至2021年4月1日接受PVI的2987例患者，比较实施SDD方案前（队列A，n=1379）与实施后（队列B，n=1608）的基线特征、围术期及术后医疗资源利用、费用和临床结局，采用双变量和多变量分析。
AI.result: 队列B vs 队列A：90天全因死亡率更低（0% vs 0.3%，P=0.031）；1年内再消融（P=0.286）、出血（P=0.177）、30天内心脏压塞（P=0.157）、膈神经损伤（P=0.984）、72小时内血栓栓塞（P=0.212）及血管并发症（P=0.290）均无差异。围术期住院费用（€721.52 vs €1011.78，P<0.001）及围术期+术后总费用（€840.37 vs €1152.94，P<0.001）显著降低；调整基线特征后，实施后队列每例患者总费用平均低€315。
AI.conclusion: 实施SDD方案与相当并发症发生率相关，同时显著降低围术期及术后医疗资源利用和费用，提升患者价值，提示进一步降本增效空间；但为单中心回顾性研究，结论需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
目的：肺静脉隔离（PVI）是治疗日益流行的房颤的有效干预措施。同日出院（SDD）是限制手术相关费用的策略性方法。本研究旨在比较实施SDD方案前后的医疗资源利用、费用和临床结局。

方法和结果：这项回顾性研究纳入2016年1月1日至2021年4月1日期间接受PVI的2987例患者。使用双变量和多变量分析比较实施SDD方案前（队列A；n = 1379）和后（队列B；n = 1608）的基线特征、术前、围术期和术后医疗资源利用及临床结局。结果显示，与队列A相比，队列B的全因90天死亡率更低（0% vs. 0.3%，P = 0.031），1年内再消融无差异（P = 0.286），并发症方面也无差异：出血（P = 0.177）、30天内心脏压塞（P = 0.157）、膈神经损伤（P = 0.984）、72小时内血栓栓塞并发症（P = 0.212）或血管并发症（P = 0.290）。在医疗资源利用和费用方面，队列B的围术期住院费用显著更低（€721.52 vs. €1011.78，P < 0.001），围术期和术后总费用也更低（€840.37 vs. €1152.94，P < 0.001）。对所有基线特征进行调整后，实施后队列每例患者的总费用平均低€315。

结论：实施SDD方案与相当的并发症发生率相关，同时显著降低了围术期和术后医疗资源利用及费用，从而提升了患者价值。这表明存在进一步降低费用和提高效率的潜在空间。

title: Histology analysis images for sinus rhythm and atrial fibrillation patients
summary: Annotated ZEN Lite czi raw histology image files associated with the paper: "Microscopic Structural Remodelling in Atrial Fibrillation: Differences Between Paroxysmal and Persistent Disease", also have manual annotations of cell boundaries and nuclei centres for selected cells on each image.

AI.tldr: 该数据集提供窦性心律与房颤患者心房组织ZEN Lite原始组织学图像及细胞边界与核中心标注，用于比较阵发性与持续性房颤的微观结构重构。
AI.motivation: 房颤的微观结构重构（如细胞排列、纤维化等）在阵发性与持续性房颤之间可能存在差异，但既往缺乏公开可用的、带细胞级标注的心房组织学图像数据，限制了定量组织学分析的可重复性与深入比较。

AI.conclusion: 该数据集为房颤微观结构重构的定量组织学研究提供可复用的图像与标注资源，支持阵发性与持续性房颤的组织学比较；但摘要未提供样本量、临床结局或统计结果，其临床意义与局限性需结合原论文全文评估。

summary_zh: 与论文《心房颤动中的微观结构重构：阵发性与持续性疾病的差异》相关的带注释 ZEN Lite czi 原始组织学图像文件，每张图像上还包含对选定细胞的手动标注的细胞边界和细胞核中心。

title: Preliminary exploration of differentially expressed circular RNAs for discriminating atrial fibrillation-related stroke.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Few studies have investigated the detection of circular RNAs (circRNAs) in peripheral blood to discriminate stroke risk in atrial fibrillation (AF). The aim of this study is to identify differentially expressed circRNAs in AF-related stroke in peripheral blood and provide a possible new biomarker for discriminating AF-related stroke.

METHODS: A total of 23 patients with AF-related stroke and 23 AF patients hospitalized at Taizhou People's Hospital between August 2020 and December 2020 were enrolled in the study. Peripheral blood samples from three AF-related stroke patients and three AF patients were randomly selected for bioinformatics analysis based on whole-transcriptome sequencing technology. Quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR) was used to validate the microarray hybridization results in the remaining 20 AF-related stroke patients and 20 AF patients. CircRNA-miRNA networks were constructed using Cytoscape 3.4.0 (http://cytoscape.org/). The discriminative effect of differentially expressed circRNAs on AF-related stroke was explored using ROC curves.

RESULTS: A total of 15 circRNAs were identified as differentially expressed between AF-related stroke patients and AF patients, comprising 8 upregulated and 7 downregulated circRNAs. Differentially expressed circRNA-related signaling pathways were mainly involved in signal transduction, infectious diseases, and immune system processes. circRNA_08148, circRNA_12852, and circRNA_00199 emerged as the top three circRNAs with the highest number of binding nodes in the circRNA-miRNA networks. qRT-PCR validation confirmed significant differential expression for three upregulated circRNAs (p < 0.05 or p < 0.01 for circRNA_00199, circRNA_06049, and circRNA_12852) and two of the three downregulated circRNAs (p < 0.05 or p < 0.01 for circRNA_11414 and circRNA_09151). circRNA_12852 was identified as an independent risk factor for stroke in AF patients after adjusting for the D-dimer level and neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (odds ratio (OR): 1.80, 95% CI: 1.150-2.817, p-value: 0.01). High expression of circRNA_12852 demonstrated some discriminative value for AF-related stroke (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC): 0.810, 95% CI: 0.662-0.958, p-value: 0.0008).

CONCLUSIONS: Compared with AF patients, those with AF- related stroke exhibited differentially expressed circRNAs. circRNA_08148, circRNA_12852, and circRNA_00199 emerged as the top three circRNAs with the highest number of binding nodes within the co-expression network. circRNA_12852 was identified as an independent risk factor for discriminating AF-related stroke.

AI.tldr: 房颤相关卒中患者外周血存在差异表达环状RNA，其中circRNA_12852为独立危险因素，对鉴别房颤相关卒中具有一定价值（AUC 0.810）。
AI.motivation: 目前通过外周血环状RNA检测来区分房颤患者卒中风险的研究很少，临床缺乏可用的分子标志物来识别房颤相关卒中高危患者，本研究旨在寻找可能的新的生物标志物。
AI.method: 单中心病例对照研究，纳入2020年8月至12月泰州市人民医院23例房颤相关卒中患者与23例房颤患者。随机选取各3例进行全转录组测序生物信息学分析，其余各20例用qRT-PCR验证；用Cytoscape 3.4.0构建circRNA-miRNA网络，用ROC曲线评估鉴别效能，并以D-二聚体和中性粒细胞/淋巴细胞比值校正后行多因素分析。
AI.result: 共鉴定出15个差异表达circRNA（8个上调、7个下调），相关通路主要涉及信号转导、感染性疾病和免疫系统过程；circRNA_08148、circRNA_12852、circRNA_00199为网络中结合节点数最多的前三位。qRT-PCR验证显示circRNA_00199、circRNA_06049、circRNA_12852（上调）及circRNA_11414、circRNA_09151（下调）差异显著（P<0.05或P<0.01）。校正D-二聚体与中性粒细胞/淋巴细胞比值后，circRNA_12852为房颤患者卒中的独立危险因素（OR 1.80，95%CI 1.150-2.817，P=0.01）；其高表达对房颤相关卒中的鉴别价值为AUC 0.810（95%CI 0.662-0.958，P=0.0008）。
AI.conclusion: 房颤相关卒中患者与房颤患者外周血circRNA表达谱存在差异，circRNA_12852是鉴别房颤相关卒中的独立危险因素，有望成为候选生物标志物。但本研究样本量小、为单中心初步探索，缺乏外部验证，距临床应用尚有距离，需更大样本前瞻性研究证实。

summary_zh:
背景：很少有研究探讨通过检测外周血中的环状RNA（circRNAs）来区分心房颤动（AF）患者的卒中风险。本研究旨在识别AF相关卒中患者外周血中差异表达的circRNAs，并为区分AF相关卒中提供可能的新生物标志物。

方法：研究共纳入2020年8月至2020年12月在泰州市人民医院住院的23例AF相关卒中患者和23例AF患者。基于全转录组测序技术，随机选取3例AF相关卒中患者和3例AF患者的外周血样本进行生物信息学分析。采用实时定量聚合酶链反应（qRT-PCR）在剩余20例AF相关卒中患者和20例AF患者中验证微阵列杂交结果。使用Cytoscape 3.4.0（http://cytoscape.org/）构建circRNA-miRNA网络。利用ROC曲线探讨差异表达circRNAs对AF相关卒中的区分效果。

结果：共鉴定出15个在AF相关卒中患者与AF患者之间差异表达的circRNAs，包括8个上调circRNAs和7个下调circRNAs。差异表达circRNA相关信号通路主要涉及信号转导、感染性疾病和免疫系统过程。circRNA_08148、circRNA_12852和circRNA_00199是circRNA-miRNA网络中结合节点数最多的前三个circRNAs。qRT-PCR验证证实了三个上调circRNAs（circRNA_00199、circRNA_06049和circRNA_12852，p < 0.05或p < 0.01）和三个下调circRNAs中的两个（circRNA_11414和circRNA_09151，p < 0.05或p < 0.01）的显著差异表达。在调整D-二聚体水平和中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值后，circRNA_12852被确定为AF患者卒中的独立危险因素（比值比（OR）：1.80，95% CI：1.150-2.817，p值：0.01）。circRNA_12852的高表达对AF相关卒中显示出一定的区分价值（受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）：0.810，95% CI：0.662-0.958，p值：0.0008）。

结论：与AF患者相比，AF相关卒中患者表现出差异表达的circRNAs。circRNA_08148、circRNA_12852和circRNA_00199是共表达网络中结合节点数最多的前三个circRNAs。circRNA_12852被确定为区分AF相关卒中的独立危险因素。

title: Correlation between myocardial radiomics features at the left atrium-left atrial appendage junction and stroke risk in atrial fibrillation patients: a retrospective case-control study.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to systematically evaluate the microstructure changes of the myocardium at the left atrium-left atrial appendage (LA-LAA) junction in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF)-related cardioembolic stroke, and to explore its potential role as an imaging marker associated with stroke.

METHODS: This retrospective study included four groups: AF-related cardioembolic stroke group (n = 60), AF-non-stroke group (n = 29), non-AF-stroke (n = 53), and non-AF-non-stroke (n = 53). All subjects underwent cardiac computed tomography examination. Myocardial thickness at the LA-LAA junction was measured, and radiomics features were extracted. Radiomics features included first-order statistical features, shape features, and texture features. Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO) regression was used to screen features, and a logistic regression model combining radiomics features and clinical parameters was constructed. Group comparisons were performed using t-tests or Mann-Whitney U tests. The predictive ability of the model was evaluated with the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve, and a nomogram was used for risk assessment.

RESULTS: Compared with AF patients without stroke, patients with AF-related cardioembolic stroke significantly increased myocardial thickness at the LA-LAA junction [7.1 (6.43-8.33) mm vs. 6.58 ± 1.45 mm, p < 0.05]. In addition, multivariate logistic regression demonstrated that myocardial thickness was independently associated with AF-related cardioembolic stroke. Three radiomics features were selected by LASSO regression in AF-related cardioembolic stroke and non-AF-non-stroke patients, and a radiomics score (Rad-score) was generated. The Rad-score was statistically significant between the groups (p < 0.001). The combined model incorporating Rad-score and clinical parameters achieved an area under curve (AUC) of 0.968 in the test cohort.

CONCLUSION: Both myocardial radiomics features and myocardial thickness at the LA-LAA junction may serve as potential imaging markers associated with AF-related cardioembolic stroke. Their incremental value for stroke risk stratification beyond established clinical risk factors requires further validation in larger prospective cohorts.

AI.tldr: 房颤相关心源性卒中患者左心房-左心耳交界处心肌厚度及影像组学特征显著改变，联合模型在测试队列中预测卒中的AUC达0.968。
AI.motivation: 房颤相关心源性卒中的风险评估目前主要依赖临床评分，缺乏直接反映心房局部结构重构的影像学标志物；左心房-左心耳交界处心肌微结构改变与卒中的关系尚不明确，既往证据有限。
AI.method: 回顾性病例对照研究，纳入四组：房颤相关心源性卒中组（n=60）、房颤非卒中组（n=29）、非房颤卒中组（n=53）、非房颤非卒中组（n=53）。所有受试者接受心脏CT检查，测量左心房-左心耳交界处心肌厚度并提取影像组学特征（一阶统计、形状、纹理特征）。采用LASSO回归筛选特征，构建影像组学特征联合临床参数的logistic回归模型，以ROC曲线评估预测能力，并用列线图进行风险评估；组间比较采用t检验或Mann-Whitney U检验。
AI.result: 与房颤非卒中患者相比，房颤相关心源性卒中患者左心房-左心耳交界处心肌厚度显著增加[7.1（6.43-8.33）mm vs. 6.58±1.45 mm，p<0.05]；多因素logistic回归显示心肌厚度与房颤相关心源性卒中独立相关。在房颤相关心源性卒中与非房颤非卒中患者间，LASSO回归筛选出3个影像组学特征并生成Rad-score，组间差异有统计学意义（p<0.001）。Rad-score联合临床参数的模型在测试队列中AUC为0.968。
AI.conclusion: 左心房-左心耳交界处心肌厚度和影像组学特征可能作为房颤相关心源性卒中的潜在影像标志物，联合模型预测效能较高；但其在现有临床危险因素之外的增量价值仍需更大样本的前瞻性队列验证，且本研究为单中心回顾性设计，结论外推受限。

summary_zh:
目的：本研究旨在系统评估心房颤动（AF）相关心源性栓塞性卒中患者左心房-左心耳（LA-LAA）交界处心肌的微结构变化，并探讨其作为与卒中相关的影像学标志物的潜在作用。

方法：本回顾性研究纳入四组：AF相关心源性栓塞性卒中组（n = 60）、AF非卒中组（n = 29）、非AF卒中组（n = 53）和非AF非卒中组（n = 53）。所有受试者均接受心脏计算机断层扫描检查。测量LA-LAA交界处的心肌厚度，并提取影像组学特征。影像组学特征包括一阶统计特征、形状特征和纹理特征。使用最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）回归筛选特征，并构建结合影像组学特征和临床参数的逻辑回归模型。组间比较采用t检验或Mann-Whitney U检验。通过受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线评估模型的预测能力，并使用列线图进行风险评估。

结果：与无卒中的AF患者相比，AF相关心源性栓塞性卒中患者LA-LAA交界处的心肌厚度显著增加[7.1（6.43-8.33）mm vs. 6.58 ± 1.45 mm，p < 0.05]。此外，多因素逻辑回归显示心肌厚度与AF相关心源性栓塞性卒中独立相关。在AF相关心源性栓塞性卒中患者和非AF非卒中患者中，LASSO回归筛选出三个影像组学特征，并生成影像组学评分（Rad-score）。Rad-score在组间具有统计学显著性（p < 0.001）。结合Rad-score和临床参数的联合模型在测试队列中达到0.968的曲线下面积（AUC）。

结论：LA-LAA交界处的心肌影像组学特征和心肌厚度均可能作为与AF相关心源性栓塞性卒中相关的潜在影像学标志物。它们在既定临床危险因素之外对卒中风险分层的增量价值需要在更大的前瞻性队列中进一步验证。

title: Association between the triglyceride-high-density lipoprotein-glucose-body index and atrial fibrillation: a retrospective case-control study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The triglyceride-glucose (TyG) index is a surrogate marker of insulin resistance and has been associated with atrial fibrillation (AF) risk, but it does not capture adiposity. The triglyceride-high-density lipoprotein-glucose-body (TyHGB) index, which integrates lipid profile, glucose metabolism, and body mass index, may provide a more comprehensive metabolic assessment. However, evidence regarding its association with AF remains limited.

METHODS: This retrospective case-control study included 1,137 participants (314 non-AF controls, 414 paroxysmal AF, and 409 persistent AF). Multivariable logistic regression was performed using three hierarchical models. Restricted cubic splines were used to examine non-linear relationships. Receiver operating characteristic curves were generated to compare the predictive performance of TyHGB, TyG, and their combination.

RESULTS: Both TyHGB and TyG were independently associated with AF risk across all models (all P < 0.001). In the fully adjusted model, each one-unit increase in TyHGB was associated with a 61% increase in the odds of AF (OR 1.61, 95% CI 1.41-1.85). Significant non-linear dose-response relationships were observed for both indices (P for non-linear < 0.001). The predictive performance of TyHGB was comparable to TyG (AUC 0.716 vs. 0.717, P = 0.902). The combined model achieved the highest AUC (0.723) and significantly outperformed TyG alone (P = 0.002), though it was not superior to TyHGB alone (P = 0.366).

CONCLUSIONS: TyHGB is a novel, simple, and low-cost metabolic index independently associated with AF risk, with predictive performance comparable to TyG. It may serve as a convenient complementary marker for metabolic risk assessment in clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 在1137例回顾性病例对照研究中，TyHGB指数与房颤风险独立相关，每增加1单位房颤风险增加61%，预测性能与TyG相当。
AI.motivation: TyG指数是胰岛素抵抗的替代标志物，与房颤风险相关，但未反映肥胖程度。TyHGB指数整合了血脂、血糖和体重指数，可能提供更全面的代谢评估，但其与房颤的关联证据有限。
AI.method: 回顾性病例对照研究，纳入1137例参与者（314例非房颤对照、414例阵发性房颤、409例持续性房颤）。采用多变量logistic回归（三个层次模型）分析TyHGB与房颤的关联，限制性立方样条检验非线性关系，ROC曲线比较TyHGB、TyG及联合模型的预测性能。
AI.result: TyHGB和TyG在所有模型中均与房颤风险独立相关（均P<0.001）。完全调整模型中，TyHGB每增加1单位，房颤风险增加61%（OR 1.61，95%CI 1.41-1.85）。两者均呈显著非线性剂量反应关系（非线性P<0.001）。TyHGB预测性能与TyG相当（AUC 0.716 vs. 0.717，P=0.902）。联合模型AUC最高（0.723），显著优于单用TyG（P=0.002），但不优于单用TyHGB（P=0.366）。
AI.conclusion: TyHGB是一种新型、简单、低成本的代谢指数，与房颤风险独立相关，预测性能与TyG相当，可作为临床实践中代谢风险评估的便捷补充标志物。但本研究为回顾性设计，需前瞻性研究验证其临床效用。

summary_zh:
背景：甘油三酯-葡萄糖（TyG）指数是胰岛素抵抗的替代标志物，已被认为与心房颤动（AF）风险相关，但它不能反映肥胖程度。甘油三酯-高密度脂蛋白-葡萄糖-体重（TyHGB）指数整合了血脂谱、糖代谢和体重指数，可能提供更全面的代谢评估。然而，关于其与AF相关性的证据仍然有限。

方法：这项回顾性病例对照研究纳入了1,137名参与者（314名非AF对照、414名阵发性AF和409名持续性AF）。使用三个分层模型进行多变量逻辑回归分析。使用限制性立方样条检查非线性关系。生成受试者工作特征曲线以比较TyHGB、TyG及其组合的预测性能。

结果：在所有模型中，TyHGB和TyG均与AF风险独立相关（所有P < 0.001）。在完全调整模型中，TyHGB每增加一个单位与AF odds增加61%相关（OR 1.61，95% CI 1.41-1.85）。两种指数均观察到显著的非线性剂量反应关系（非线性P < 0.001）。TyHGB的预测性能与TyG相当（AUC 0.716 vs. 0.717，P = 0.902）。组合模型达到最高AUC（0.723），显著优于单独TyG（P = 0.002），但未优于单独TyHGB（P = 0.366）。

结论：TyHGB是一种新颖、简单且低成本的代谢指数，与AF风险独立相关，预测性能与TyG相当。它可能作为临床实践中代谢风险评估的便捷补充标志物。

title: Explainable deep learning-based classification of Wolff-Parkinson-White electrocardiographic signals.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) syndrome is a cardiac electrophysiology (EP) disorder caused by the presence of an accessory pathway (AP) that bypasses the atrioventricular node, faster ventricular activation rate, and provides a substrate for atrio-ventricular reentrant tachycardia (AVRT). Accurate localization of the AP is critical for planning and guiding catheter ablation procedures. While traditional diagnostic tree (DT) methods and more recent machine learning (ML) approaches have been proposed to predict AP location from surface electrocardiogram (ECG), they are often constrained by limited anatomical localization resolution, poor interpretability, and the use of small clinical datasets.

METHODS: In this preliminary patient-specific study, we present a Deep Learning (DL) model for the localization of single manifest APs across 24 cardiac regions, trained on a large, physiologically realistic database of synthetic ECGs generated using a personalized virtual heart model. We also integrate eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) methods, Guided Backpropagation, Grad-CAM, and Guided Grad-CAM, into the pipeline. This enables interpretation of DL decision-making and addresses one of the main barriers to clinical adoption: lack of transparency in ML predictions.

RESULTS: On the considered single heart geometry, our model achieves a localization accuracy above 94% and an average F1 score over 93%. XAI outputs are physiologically validated against known depolarization patterns, and a novel index is introduced to identify the most informative ECG leads for AP localization.

DISCUSSION: Results highlight lead V2 as the most critical, followed by aVR, and aVL in the left ventricle (LV) and V1 in the right ventricle (RV). This work demonstrates the potential of combining cardiac digital twins with explainable DL to enable accurate, transparent, and noninvasive AP localization.

AI.tldr: 基于个体化虚拟心脏模型合成心电图训练的深度学习模型，可在24个心脏区域定位单个显性旁路，准确率超94%，并确定V2导联最关键。
AI.motivation: WPW综合征由旁路引起，准确无创定位旁路对导管消融规划至关重要。传统诊断树和机器学习方法受限于解剖定位分辨率低、可解释性差及临床数据集小。
AI.method: 初步个体化研究，使用个体化虚拟心脏模型生成大规模生理逼真心电数据库，训练深度学习模型对单个显性旁路在24个心脏区域进行定位。整合Guided Backpropagation、Grad-CAM和Guided Grad-CAM等可解释AI方法，并引入新指标识别最具信息量的心电图导联。
AI.result: 在单一心脏几何模型上，定位准确率超过94%，平均F1分数超过93%。可解释AI输出经已知去极化模式生理验证，新指标显示V2导联最关键，其次为aVR和aVL（左心室）及V1（右心室）。
AI.conclusion: 结合心脏数字孪生与可解释深度学习可实现准确、透明、无创的旁路定位，有望辅助消融规划。但研究基于合成数据和单一心脏几何，临床泛化性需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
引言：Wolff-Parkinson-White（WPW）综合征是一种心脏电生理（EP）疾病，由存在绕过房室结的旁路（AP）引起，导致心室激动速率加快，并为房室折返性心动过速（AVRT）提供基质。AP的准确定位对于规划和指导导管消融手术至关重要。虽然传统的诊断树（DT）方法和较新的机器学习（ML）方法已被提出用于从体表心电图（ECG）预测AP位置，但它们通常受限于解剖定位分辨率有限、可解释性差以及使用小型临床数据集。

方法：在这项初步的患者特异性研究中，我们提出了一种深度学习（DL）模型，用于在24个心脏区域中定位单个显性AP，该模型基于使用个性化虚拟心脏模型生成的大型、生理学真实的合成ECG数据库进行训练。我们还将可解释人工智能（XAI）方法，包括引导反向传播、Grad-CAM和引导Grad-CAM，集成到流程中。这使得能够解释DL决策，并解决了临床采用的主要障碍之一：ML预测缺乏透明度。

结果：在所考虑的单心脏几何结构上，我们的模型实现了超过94%的定位准确率和超过93%的平均F1分数。XAI输出根据已知的去极化模式进行了生理学验证，并引入了一种新的指标来识别对AP定位最具信息量的ECG导联。

讨论：结果强调导联V2最为关键，其次是左心室（LV）的aVR和aVL，以及右心室（RV）的V1。这项工作展示了将心脏数字孪生与可解释DL相结合，以实现准确、透明和无创AP定位的潜力。

title: Open wavefront ablation terminates rotor-driven atrial fibrillation
summary: Introduction Atrial arrhythmias, notably atrial fibrillation (AF), exhibit complex spatiotemporal patterns that remain incompletely characterized. Based on topological constraints requiring counter-rotating reentries in two-dimensional manifolds, we present a framework classifying all atrial wavefronts into two fundamental archetypes: open and closed waves. Open waves are line-like structures bounded by endpoints that tend to self-perpetuate; closed waves are ring-like structures lacking endpoints that tend toward self-termination. Methods and Results We demonstrate that complex wavefront interactions reduce to five elementary processes: (1) Open wave creation, (2) Open wave annihilation, (3) Closed wave creation, (4) Closed wave annihilation and (5) Open wave collision. Validation within a cohort of 600 patient-specific AF simulations showed that all observed events adhered to these constructed topological rules, suggesting that complexity of fibrillatory conduction within the studied computational framework arises from simple underlying principles. Furthermore, closing all open waves, achieved a 100% success rate when electrical silence was used as the primary criteria for efficacy. Discussion This unified framework reconciles existing electrophysiological theories, including the multiple wavelet hypothesis, the mother rotor hypothesis, meandering rotors, and focal sources, while providing a foundation for optimizing clinical interventions.

AI.tldr: 在600例患者个体化房颤模拟中，闭合所有开放波可100%终止房颤，提示开放波是维持房颤的关键靶点。
AI.motivation: 房颤的复杂时空模式尚未完全阐明，现有多种假说（多发子波、母转子、游走转子、局灶源）缺乏统一框架，临床消融策略有待优化。
AI.method: 基于二维流形中反向旋转折返的拓扑约束，提出将心房波前分为开放波（线状、有端点、自我维持）和闭合波（环状、无端点、趋向自终止）的分类框架；在600例患者个体化房颤模拟中验证波前相互作用的五种基本过程，并以电静默为主要疗效标准评估闭合所有开放波的消融效果。
AI.result: 所有观察到的波前事件均符合构建的拓扑规则；闭合所有开放波后，以电静默为主要标准，房颤终止成功率达100%。摘要未报告置信区间和P值。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架调和了多发子波、母转子、游走转子和局灶源等现有电生理理论，提示开放波是维持房颤的关键结构，为优化临床消融策略提供了新思路；但结论基于计算模拟，尚需临床验证。

summary_zh: 引言：房性心律失常，尤其是心房颤动（AF），表现出复杂的时空模式，这些模式尚未被完全表征。基于二维流形中需要反向旋转折返的拓扑约束，我们提出了一个框架，将所有心房波前分类为两种基本原型：开放波和闭合波。开放波是由端点界定的线状结构，倾向于自我维持；闭合波是缺乏端点的环状结构，倾向于自我终止。方法与结果：我们证明复杂的波前相互作用可简化为五个基本过程：（1）开放波产生，（2）开放波湮灭，（3）闭合波产生，（4）闭合波湮灭和（5）开放波碰撞。在600例患者特异性AF模拟队列中的验证表明，所有观察到的事件均遵循这些构建的拓扑规则，提示在所研究的计算框架内，颤动传导的复杂性源于简单的底层原理。此外，关闭所有开放波，当以电静默作为疗效的主要标准时，达到了100%的成功率。讨论：这一统一框架调和了现有的电生理学理论，包括多子波假说、母转子假说、游走转子和局灶源，同时为优化临床干预提供了基础。

title: Systems-based perspectives on atrial fibrillation: integrating classification and severity
journal: Indian Journal of Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery

title: Clinical Advantages and Pitfalls of Pulsed Field Ablation: How to Prevent ALH Syndrome.
summary: Catheter ablation for tachyarrhythmias was first introduced in the early 1980s using direct-current (DC) energy. Following the clinical introduction of radiofrequency (RF) ablation in the late 1980s, thermal ablation technologies became the foundation of catheter ablation because of their superior controllability, efficacy, and safety. In 2014, Wittkampf developed a DC-energy-delivery catheter system preventing electrical arcing, thereby initiating a modern "revival of DC-ablation" based on catheter ablation using electroporation. Subsequent development of high-voltage, short-duration pulse-train delivery led to the emergence of pulsed field ablation (PFA). Exposure of myocytes to high-voltage electric fields induces reversible electroporation through nanoscale pore formation within the lipid bilayer, whereas higher electric-field delivery produces irreversible electroporation, resulting in permanent membrane disruption, apoptosis, and durable lesion formation. PFA is regarded as a predominantly nonthermal and potentially tissue-selective ablation modality. Nevertheless, clinical trials of pulmonary vein isolation for atrial fibrillation have demonstrated that PFA is noninferior to conventional thermal ablation strategies, although clear superiority-other than shorter procedural times-has not yet been established. Importantly, recent studies suggest that electrode-tissue contact remains a critical determinant of durable lesion formation. Accumulating evidence indicates that PFA is associated with new complications not commonly observed with thermal ablation, including acute kidney injury, stroke, coronary vasospasm, myocardial ischemia, ventricular fibrillation, and sudden cardiac death. Although the mechanisms remain incompletely understood, hemolysis-related injury induced by high-voltage pulse delivery may represent an important contributing mechanism. Development of PFA systems capable of real-time prediction of irreversible lesion size may be essential for optimizing both procedural efficacy and safety.

AI.tldr: 脉冲场消融（PFA）在房颤肺静脉隔离中不劣于传统热消融，但可导致急性肾损伤、卒中、冠脉痉挛等独特并发症，需警惕ALH综合征。
AI.motivation: PFA作为非热消融新技术，虽在肺静脉隔离中显示不劣于热消融，但近期研究发现其可引发热消融不常见的并发症，如急性肾损伤、卒中、冠脉痉挛等，机制未明，需明确临床优势与陷阱以优化安全策略。
AI.method: 本文为综述，总结PFA的发展历程、电穿孔机制、临床研究证据（肺静脉隔离中不劣于热消融但未确立优效性）、电极-组织接触对持久损伤的影响，以及新报告的并发症（急性肾损伤、卒中、冠脉痉挛、心肌缺血、室颤、心脏性猝死）和可能机制（溶血相关损伤）。摘要未报告具体研究样本量、终点定义及统计方法。
AI.result: PFA在房颤肺静脉隔离中不劣于传统热消融，但除手术时间缩短外未确立明确优效性；电极-组织接触是持久损伤的关键决定因素；PFA与急性肾损伤、卒中、冠脉痉挛、心肌缺血、室颤及心脏性猝死等新并发症相关，机制可能涉及高压脉冲导致的溶血相关损伤。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: PFA是颇具前景的非热消融方式，但临床应用中需警惕其独特并发症（ALH综合征），未来需开发能实时预测不可逆损伤范围的PFA系统以优化疗效与安全性；当前证据限于综述，缺乏定量数据，需进一步研究明确机制与预防策略。

summary_zh: 导管消融治疗快速性心律失常最初于20世纪80年代初采用直流电（DC）能量引入。20世纪80年代末射频（RF）消融临床引入后，热消融技术因其优越的可控性、有效性和安全性成为导管消融的基础。2014年，Wittkampf开发了一种防止电弧的直流能量输送导管系统，从而开启了基于电穿孔导管消融的现代“直流消融复兴”。随后高压短时脉冲串输送的发展导致了脉冲场消融（PFA）的出现。将心肌细胞暴露于高压电场可通过脂质双层内纳米级孔形成诱导可逆电穿孔，而更高电场的输送则产生不可逆电穿孔，导致永久性膜破坏、凋亡和持久损伤形成。PFA被认为是一种主要非热且潜在组织选择性的消融方式。然而，针对心房颤动肺静脉隔离的临床试验已证明PFA不劣于传统热消融策略，尽管除缩短手术时间外的明确优越性尚未确立。重要的是，近期研究表明电极-组织接触仍是持久损伤形成的关键决定因素。越来越多的证据表明PFA与热消融不常见的新并发症相关，包括急性肾损伤、卒中、冠状动脉痉挛、心肌缺血、心室颤动和心脏性猝死。尽管机制尚未完全明了，高压脉冲输送诱导的溶血相关损伤可能是重要的促成机制。开发能够实时预测不可逆损伤大小的PFA系统可能对优化手术疗效和安全性至关重要。

title: Right Atrium-Dominant Single-Loop Biatrial Tachycardia Mimicking Reverse Typical Atrial Flutter After Mitral Valve Repair via a Superior Transseptal Approach
summary: Following a superior transseptal approach, extensive postoperative septal conduction impairment facilitated a right atrium-dominant single-loop biatrial tachycardia mimicking reverse typical atrial flutter. Detailed biatrial mapping and entrainment revealed limited left atrial participation, highlighting the importance of recognizing biatrial circuits in patients with prior septal surgery.

AI.tldr: 二尖瓣修复术后经上房间隔入路患者可出现右房主导的单环双房心动过速，模拟逆向典型房扑，双房标测与拖拽证实左房参与有限。
AI.motivation: 经上房间隔入路行二尖瓣手术后，房间隔传导广泛受损，可能形成复杂房性心动过速环路；既往对术后双房折返环路的识别经验有限，易误判为典型房扑而消融失败。
AI.method: 病例报告（摘要未报告样本量、研究类型细节及统计方法）。对象为二尖瓣修复术后经上房间隔入路发生房性心动过速的患者；干预为详细双房三维电解剖标测与拖拽（entrainment）标测，明确心动过速环路及左右房参与程度。终点为环路机制判定。
AI.result: 标测显示为右房主导的单环双房心动过速，环路模拟逆向典型房扑；拖拽标测证实左房参与有限。摘要未报告具体周期长度、拖拽后返回周期等数值。
AI.conclusion: 对既往接受房间隔手术的患者，应警惕双房折返环路，不能仅凭体表心电图模拟典型房扑即按常规房扑消融；需行双房详细标测与拖拽以明确环路。本文为单例报告，结论的外推受限。

summary_zh: 经上房间隔入路后，广泛的术后间隔传导障碍促发了一种以右心房为主导、模拟逆典型心房扑动的单环双房心动过速。详细的双房标测与拖带显示左心房参与有限，凸显了在既往接受间隔手术的患者中识别双房折返环的重要性。

title: Prognostic Value of Preoperative 2-Dimensional Left Ventricular, Right Ventricular, and Left Atrial Strain in Patients Undergoing Off-Pump Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting: A Prospective Observational Study.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: To determine whether preoperative speckle-tracking strain of the left ventricle, right ventricle, and left atrium predicts new-onset postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) and other adverse outcomes after off-pump coronary artery bypass grafting (OPCAB).

DESIGN: Prospective, single-center, observational, prognostic cohort study.

SETTING: Tertiary-care university cardiac surgical center in western India.

PARTICIPANTS: One hundred fifty consecutive adults undergoing elective isolated OPCAB (January 2024-March 2025).

INTERVENTIONS: None.

MEASUREMENTS AND MAIN RESULTS: Transthoracic echocardiography with offline speckle tracking was performed within 24 hours before surgery; left ventricular (LV) global longitudinal strain (GLS), right ventricular free-wall longitudinal strain (RVFWLS) and left atrial (LA) reservoir strain (peak atrial longitudinal strain [PALS]) were measured. POAF occurred in 62 of 150 patients (41.3%). Patients with POAF had less negative LV GLS (-16.07% v -17.85%), less negative RVFWLS (-21.85% v -24.47%), lower PALS (32.45% v 38.31%), and larger LA volume index (LAVI) (43.71 mL/m² v 33.01 mL/m²) (all p < 0.001). LAVI showed the highest discrimination (area under the curve [AUC], 0.867), followed by RVFWLS (AUC, 0.771), LV GLS (AUC, 0.766), and PALS (AUC, 0.765); LV ejection fraction did not discriminate (AUC, 0.541). After adjustment for age, European System for Cardiac Operative Risk Evaluation (EuroSCORE) II, and LAVI, RVFWLS (adjusted odds ratio, 1.436; p = 0.008) and PALS (1.118 per 1% decrement, p = 0.039) were the only strain parameters that remained independent predictors, together with LAVI and age. RVFWLS was also independently associated with prolonged inotropic support beyond 48 hours.

CONCLUSIONS: Preoperative strain of the left ventricle, right ventricle, and left atrium carries prognostic information for POAF after OPCAB, but only RVFWLS and LA reservoir strain were independent strain predictors after adjustment; these parameters may identify a high-risk subgroup warranting intensified rhythm monitoring and prophylaxis. These associations do not establish causation.

AI.tldr: 在择期非体外循环冠脉搭桥患者中，术前右室游离壁纵向应变和左房储器应变是术后新发房颤的独立预测因子，而左室整体纵向应变和左室射血分数并非独立预测因子。
AI.motivation: 术后新发房颤是非体外循环冠脉搭桥术后常见并发症，既往风险分层多依赖左室射血分数和左房大小，但术前左室、右室及左房心肌应变对术后房颤的预测价值尚不明确，尤其缺乏同时评估三个腔室应变的前瞻性证据。
AI.method: 前瞻性、单中心、观察性预后队列研究，纳入150例连续接受择期单纯非体外循环冠脉搭桥的成人患者（2024年1月至2025年3月）。术前24小时内行经胸超声心动图及离线斑点追踪，测量左室整体纵向应变、右室游离壁纵向应变和左房储器应变（即峰值心房纵向应变），并计算左房容积指数。主要终点为术后新发房颤，采用受试者工作特征曲线及多因素回归分析，校正年龄、EuroSCORE II和左房容积指数。
AI.result: 术后新发房颤发生率为41.3%（62/150）。房颤组左室整体纵向应变较非房颤组负值更小（-16.07% vs -17.85%），右室游离壁纵向应变负值更小（-21.85% vs -24.47%），左房储器应变更低（32.45% vs 38.31%），左房容积指数更大（43.71 vs 33.01 mL/m²），差异均有统计学意义（P<0.001）。左房容积指数鉴别能力最高（AUC 0.867），其次为右室游离壁纵向应变（AUC 0.771）、左室整体纵向应变（AUC 0.766）和左房储器应变（AUC 0.765）；左室射血分数无鉴别能力（AUC 0.541）。校正年龄、EuroSCORE II和左房容积指数后，仅右室游离壁纵向应变（校正OR 1.436，P=0.008）和左房储器应变（每降低1%，OR 1.118，P=0.039）仍为独立预测因子，左房容积指数和年龄亦为独立预测因子。右室游离壁纵向应变还与术后正性肌力药物支持超过48小时独立相关。
AI.conclusion: 术前左室、右室和左房应变均对非体外循环冠脉搭桥术后新发房颤具有预后价值，但校正混杂因素后仅右室游离壁纵向应变和左房储器应变是独立的应变预测因子，可用于识别需要加强心律监测和预防的高危患者。上述关联不能确立因果关系，且为单中心研究，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh:
目的：确定术前左心室、右心室和左心房的斑点追踪应变是否可预测非体外循环冠状动脉旁路移植术（OPCAB）后新发术后心房颤动（POAF）及其他不良结局。

设计：前瞻性、单中心、观察性、预后队列研究。

地点：印度西部一家三级保健大学心脏外科中心。

参与者：连续150例接受择期孤立OPCAB的成人（2024年1月至2025年3月）。

干预：无。

测量与主要结果：术前24小时内进行经胸超声心动图并离线斑点追踪；测量左心室（LV）整体纵向应变（GLS）、右心室游离壁纵向应变（RVFWLS）和左心房（LA）储备应变（心房纵向峰值应变[PALS]）。150例患者中62例（41.3%）发生POAF。POAF患者的LV GLS负值较小（-16.07% vs -17.85%），RVFWLS负值较小（-21.85% vs -24.47%），PALS较低（32.45% vs 38.31%），LA容积指数（LAVI）较大（43.71 mL/m² vs 33.01 mL/m²）（所有p < 0.001）。LAVI显示出最高的判别能力（曲线下面积[AUC]，0.867），其次是RVFWLS（AUC，0.771）、LV GLS（AUC，0.766）和PALS（AUC，0.765）；LV射血分数无判别能力（AUC，0.541）。调整年龄、欧洲心脏手术风险评估系统（EuroSCORE）II和LAVI后，RVFWLS（调整比值比，1.436；p = 0.008）和PALS（每降低1%，1.118；p = 0.039）是仅有的仍为独立预测因素的应变参数，与LAVI和年龄一起。RVFWLS还与超过48小时的延长正性肌力药物支持独立相关。

结论：术前左心室、右心室和左心房应变对OPCAB后POAF具有预后信息，但调整后仅RVFWLS和LA储备应变是独立的应变预测因素；这些参数可能识别需要加强心律监测和预防的高危亚组。这些关联不能确立因果关系。

title: Temporal Association Between Aromatase Inhibitor Initiation and New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation: A Case Report
summary: Introduction Breast cancer is the most prevalent cancer among women worldwide with a higher probability of diagnosis in the postmenopausal years. Aromatase inhibitors (AIs) block the aromatase enzyme responsible for converting androgens into estrogens in the peripheral tissues, which become the main source for estrogen production in this population. Estrogen plays a key role in promoting vasodilation and inhibiting vascular injury and atherosclerosis development. Reduced levels can contribute to adipocyte hyperplasia, insulin resistance, and dyslipidemia, all of which are risk factors for atrial fibrillation.Patient case We describe the case of a 71-year-old postmenopausal female who presented to the emergency department with shortness of breath and was subsequently diagnosed with new-onset atrial fibrillation. This case report aims to evaluate whether there is a potential correlation between the initiation of an AI and the development of atrial arrhythmias.Discussion While existing data suggest an association between AI use and atrial fibrillation, there lacks an elaborate understanding of the temporal relationship between the 2. This case highlights a potential association between AI therapy and unusually rapid-onset atrial fibrillation, demonstrating the need for further research and increased clinical awareness when managing patients receiving these treatments.

AI.tldr: 一例71岁绝经后乳腺癌患者启动芳香化酶抑制剂后短期内新发房颤，提示两者可能存在时间关联。
AI.motivation: 芳香化酶抑制剂（AI）通过抑制雄激素向雌激素转化降低雌激素水平，而雌激素具有血管保护作用；其减少可导致脂肪细胞增生、胰岛素抵抗和血脂异常等房颤危险因素。既往数据提示AI使用与房颤相关，但两者时间关系尚不明确，本研究旨在通过病例报告探讨AI启动与新发房性心律失常之间的潜在时间关联。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为1例71岁绝经后女性乳腺癌患者，因呼吸困难就诊急诊科，随后诊断为新发房颤。暴露为芳香化酶抑制剂启动，主要观察终点为启动AI后新发房颤的发生及时间关系。统计方法：摘要未报告。
AI.result: 该患者启动AI后出现异常快速起病的新发房颤，表现为呼吸困难。摘要未报告具体时间间隔、心电图参数、实验室检查及任何效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示AI治疗与新发房颤之间可能存在时间关联，且起病较快，提示临床医生在管理接受AI治疗的患者时应提高对房颤的警惕。但作为单例病例报告，无法确立因果关系，结论外推受限，需进一步研究明确两者关系。

summary_zh:
引言：乳腺癌是全球女性中最常见的癌症，在绝经后女性中诊断概率更高。芳香化酶抑制剂（AIs）阻断芳香化酶，该酶负责在外周组织中将雄激素转化为雌激素，而外周组织成为该人群雌激素产生的主要来源。雌激素在促进血管舒张和抑制血管损伤及动脉粥样硬化发展中起关键作用。雌激素水平降低可导致脂肪细胞增生、胰岛素抵抗和血脂异常，这些都是心房颤动的危险因素。

患者病例：我们描述了一例71岁绝经后女性，因呼吸困难就诊于急诊科，随后被诊断为新发心房颤动。本病例报告旨在评估开始使用AI与发生房性心律失常之间是否存在潜在相关性。

讨论：虽然现有数据提示AI使用与心房颤动之间存在关联，但对两者之间的时间关系缺乏详尽的理解。本病例突出了AI治疗与异常快速发作的心房颤动之间的潜在关联，表明需要进一步研究，并在管理接受这些治疗的患者时提高临床认识。

title: Acute Regional Atrial Metabolic Inflexibility in Atrial Fibrillation: Evidence From Human Vein of Marshall Arteriovenous Samplings.
Effects of Dual-Energy Lattice-Tip Catheter Ablation of Ventricular Arrhythmias on Cardiac Implantable Electronic Device Performance.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The Sphere-9 lattice-tip catheter (Affera, Medtronic) enables delivery of both radiofrequency ablation (RFA) and pulsed field ablation (PFA) for ventricular arrhythmia (VA) ablation. Data on its impact on cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs) are limited.

OBJECTIVES: This study sought to evaluate changes in CIED function following VA ablation using the Sphere-9 catheter.

METHODS: We reviewed 65 consecutive patients (median age 71 years, 94% male, 63% ischemic cardiomyopathy, median left ventricular ejection fraction 31%) with pre-existing CIEDs who underwent VA ablation (62 ventricular tachycardia [95%], 3 premature ventricular contraction [5%]) using the Sphere-9 catheter (combined RFA/PFA (53 [82%]), RFA alone (6 [9%]), PFA alone (6 [9%])). Device interrogation was performed within 30 days preprocedure, within 7 days postprocedure, and at 3-month (+/- 30 days) follow-up.

RESULTS: At 3-months, right ventricular leads demonstrated reduced sensing amplitude (11.7-10.0 mV, P = 0.04), pacing impedance (441-422 Ω, P < 0.001), shock impedance (64-59 Ω, P = 0.01), and increased capture threshold (0.9-1.0 V at 0.4-0.5 milliseconds, P = 0.03). Left ventricular (LV) leads demonstrated reduced pacing impedance (544-475 Ω, P = 0.04), whereas LV capture threshold remained elevated (1.0-1.4 V, P = 0.08). Right atrial lead parameters remained stable. No patient required CIED revision. One patient experienced cardiac resynchronization therapy-D pulse generator failure during PFA delivery 7.5 mm from an LV lead tip electrode, requiring generator replacement.

CONCLUSIONS: Ventricular arrhythmia ablation using the Sphere-9 dual-energy lattice-tip catheter was associated with small but persistent changes in right and left ventricular lead parameters. Serious CIED interactions were uncommon, and further studies are needed to better understand the underlying mechanisms.

AI.tldr: Sphere-9双能量网格头导管行室性心律失常消融后，右室导线感知、阻抗及起搏阈值出现小幅但持续的变化，左室导线起搏阻抗降低，严重CIED交互罕见。
AI.motivation: Sphere-9网格头导管可同时释放射频消融和脉冲场消融用于室性心律失常消融，但其对已植入心脏植入式电子设备功能的影响数据有限，临床亟需明确其安全性。
AI.method: 回顾性研究纳入65例既往有CIED的连续患者（中位年龄71岁，94%男性，63%缺血性心肌病，中位LVEF 31%），接受Sphere-9导管室性心律失常消融（室速62例[95%]，室早3例[5%]；联合RFA/PFA 53例[82%]，单纯RFA 6例[9%]，单纯PFA 6例[9%]）。术前30天内、术后7天内及3个月（±30天）行CIED程控检查。
AI.result: 3个月随访时，右室导线感知振幅降低（11.7→10.0 mV，P=0.04），起搏阻抗降低（441→422 Ω，P<0.001），除颤阻抗降低（64→59 Ω，P=0.01），起搏阈值升高（0.9→1.0 V @0.4-0.5 ms，P=0.03）。左室导线起搏阻抗降低（544→475 Ω，P=0.04），左室起搏阈值持续升高（1.0→1.4 V，P=0.08）。右房导线参数稳定。无患者需CIED修正。1例在距左室导线尖端7.5 mm处行PFA时发生CRT-D脉冲发生器故障，需更换发生器。
AI.conclusion: Sphere-9双能量网格头导管行室性心律失常消融与右室和左室导线参数小幅但持续的变化相关，严重CIED交互不常见。临床实践中需加强术后CIED程控监测，尤其关注左室导线阈值变化及PFA靠近导线时的潜在风险；具体机制有待进一步研究。

summary_zh:
背景：Sphere-9 网格头端导管（Affera，Medtronic）可同时实施射频消融（RFA）和脉冲场消融（PFA）用于室性心律失常（VA）消融。关于其对心脏植入式电子装置（CIED）影响的数据有限。

目的：本研究旨在评估使用 Sphere-9 导管进行 VA 消融后 CIED 功能的变化。

方法：我们回顾了 65 例连续的存在 CIED 的患者（中位年龄 71 岁，94% 男性，63% 缺血性心肌病，中位左心室射血分数 31%），这些患者使用 Sphere-9 导管接受了 VA 消融（62 例室性心动过速 [95%]，3 例室性早搏 [5%]），采用联合 RFA/PFA（53 例 [82%]）、单独 RFA（6 例 [9%]）、单独 PFA（6 例 [9%]）。在术前 30 天内、术后 7 天内以及 3 个月（± 30 天）随访时进行装置程控检查。

结果：在 3 个月时，右心室导线表现出感知振幅降低（11.7-10.0 mV，P = 0.04）、起搏阻抗降低（441-422 Ω，P < 0.001）、除颤阻抗降低（64-59 Ω，P = 0.01），以及起搏阈值升高（0.4-0.5 毫秒下 0.9-1.0 V，P = 0.03）。左心室（LV）导线表现出起搏阻抗降低（544-475 Ω，P = 0.04），而 LV 起搏阈值保持升高（1.0-1.4 V，P = 0.08）。右心房导线参数保持稳定。没有患者需要 CIED 修正。一名患者在距离 LV 导线尖端电极 7.5 mm 处进行 PFA 释放时发生心脏再同步治疗-D 脉冲发生器故障，需要更换发生器。

结论：使用 Sphere-9 双能量网格头端导管进行室性心律失常消融与右心室和左心室导线参数微小但持续的变化相关。严重的 CIED 相互作用不常见，需要进一步研究以更好地理解潜在机制。

title: Adjunctive Low-Voltage Area Ablation Reduces Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence in Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review, Meta-Analysis, and Trial Sequential Analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Adjunctive low-voltage area ablation (LVAA) has been proposed as a substrate modification strategy to improve outcomes of catheter ablation in persistent atrial fibrillation (AF); however, randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating LVAA have yielded inconsistent findings.

OBJECTIVES: This meta-analysis sought to evaluate the efficacy of LVAA in addition to pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) compared with PVI alone in patients with persistent AF.

METHODS: Electronic databases were searched from inception to September 2026 for eligible RCTs. The primary endpoint was recurrent AF/atrial tachyarrhythmia ≥12 months after index ablation. Secondary endpoints included major periprocedural complications and procedural durations. Meta-analyses were performed using random-effects models. Trial sequential analysis was performed to assess the robustness of cumulative evidence.

RESULTS: Seven RCTs comprising 1,487 participants (weighted mean age 68 years, 60% male) were included. Compared with PVI alone, PVI + LVAA was associated with significantly lower recurrence of AF/atrial tachyarrhythmia (HR: 0.67; 95% CI: 0.50-0.88; I2 = 55%; P = 0.004). Trial sequential analysis demonstrated that the cumulative Z-curve crossed the monitoring boundary for benefit, supporting the robustness of the observed treatment effect. Adjunctive LVAA increased total procedure duration (mean difference: 30.5 minutes; 95% CI: 5.8-55.2; P = 0.02) and radiofrequency ablation duration (mean difference: 12.3 minutes; 95% CI: 5.4-19.1; P < 0.001) without increasing fluoroscopy time or major periprocedural complications (relative risk: 1.12; 95% CI: 0.60-2.10; P = 0.7).

CONCLUSIONS: Among patients with persistent AF, adjunctive LVAA in addition to PVI significantly reduces recurrent atrial tachyarrhythmia compared with PVI alone. These findings support electroanatomically guided substrate modification as a promising individualized ablation strategy in persistent AF.

title: Increased Heart Failure Risk After Low-Voltage-Area Ablation in Patients With Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Extensive atrial ablation may impair atrial function; however, its impact on long-term heart failure (HF) risk remains unclear.

OBJECTIVES: This study sought to evaluate the association between low-voltage area (LVA) ablation and HF outcomes after catheter ablation for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF).

METHODS: This was a long-term follow-up analysis of the Volatile Coronary Lesion and Obstructive Nodal Atrial Fibrillation trial. A total of 398 patients were followed for up to 7 years and classified into 3 groups: no LVAs (group A), LVAs with LVA ablation (group B), and LVAs without LVA ablation (group C). The primary outcome was HF hospitalization.

RESULTS: During a median follow-up of 1,660 (735-2,555) days, HF hospitalization occurred in 21 patients. Sinus rhythm was maintained in 96% of patients, with no differences among groups (P = 0.26). Patients with LVAs had a higher incidence of HF hospitalization than those without (18% vs 3%; P < 0.001). Among patients with LVAs, HF hospitalization occurred more frequently in those undergoing LVA ablation (30% vs 6%; P = 0.01). In a competing-risk analysis accounting for all-cause death, the cumulative incidence of HF hospitalization remained significantly higher in patients undergoing LVA ablation (Gray's test, P = 0.042). Among patients who experienced HF hospitalization, most events occurred during documented sinus rhythm.

CONCLUSIONS: Among patients with paroxysmal AF and LVAs, LVA ablation was associated with a higher incidence of HF hospitalization despite a high rate of sinus rhythm maintenance. Given the limited sample size and number of events, these findings should be considered exploratory and hypothesis-generating, and warrant confirmation in larger prospective studies.

AI.method: 本研究为Volatile Coronary Lesion and Obstructive Nodal Atrial Fibrillation试验的长期随访分析，共纳入398例患者，随访长达7年，分为三组：无LVA组（A组）、有LVA并接受LVA消融组（B组）、有LVA未接受LVA消融组（C组）。主要终点为心衰住院。采用竞争风险分析（考虑全因死亡）评估累积发生率。
AI.result: 中位随访1660天（735-2555天）期间，21例患者发生心衰住院。窦性心律维持率为96%，组间无差异（P=0.26）。有LVA患者心衰住院发生率高于无LVA患者（18% vs 3%；P<0.001）。在有LVA患者中，接受LVA消融者心衰住院更常见（30% vs 6%；P=0.01）。竞争风险分析显示，LVA消融组心衰住院累积发生率仍显著更高（Gray's检验，P=0.042）。发生心衰住院的患者中，多数事件发生在记录到窦性心律时。

title: Impact of Early Atrial Tachyarrhythmia Within the Blanking Period on Late Recurrence After Pulsed Field Ablation of Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Early atrial tachyarrhythmias (ERAT) occurring during the first 3 months after atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation were not traditionally considered a treatment failure, and this defined the blanking period after thermal energy ablations. More recent data suggest that the blanking period after pulsed field ablation (PFA) is shorter. We hypothesized that the traditional concept of "blanking period" does not apply to PFA for AF.

OBJECTIVES: This study sought to evaluate whether ERAT during the 3 months after PFA for AF predicts late recurrence and whether or not the timing of ERAT affects late recurrences.

METHODS: All consecutive patients undergoing PFA for AF at our institution (Feb 2024- March 2025) were enrolled in a prospective registry and followed to assess arrhythmia recurrences. ERAT was defined as atrial fibrillation or flutter lasting ≥30 seconds within 90 days. Late arrhythmia recurrences (LRAT) were defined as recurrences after 90 days.

RESULTS: Among 1,608 patients followed for 1 year, 334 (20.8%) experienced ERAT and were more likely to experience LRAT than those patients without ERAT (68.4% vs 20.3%, P < 0.001). In multivariable Cox analyses, ERAT was independently associated with LRAT (HR: 4.89; 95% CI: 4.04-5.93; P < 0.001). The risk of LRAT was consistently elevated using 30-day and 60-day ERAT timing cutoffs: ERAT ≤30 vs 31-90 days (LRAT = 70.4% vs 65.5%; P = 0.41; adjusted HR: 5.40 vs 4.34 respectively compared with no ERAT) and ERAT ≤60 vs 61-90 days (LRAT = 68.6% vs 67.1%; P = 0.88; adjusted HR: 4.91 vs 4.83 respectively) compared with no ERAT. In secondary analyses, LRAT rates were similar in ERAT patients with or without cardioversion (73% vs 66.7%, P = 0.29). Interaction testing showed no significant differences in these HRs across ERAT-timing or cardioversion subgroups (all P > 0.05). Moreover, ERAT was associated with a higher need for cardioversion (25.1% vs 7.2%, P < 0.001; HR: 1.49; 95% CI: 1.10-2.02; P = 0.008) and late arrhythmia recurrences compared with patients without ERAT.

CONCLUSIONS: After PFA for AF, atrial tachyarrhythmias at any time within the first 3 months, regardless of timing or need for cardioversion, strongly predict late recurrence and warrant increased monitoring intensity in the early postablation period.

AI.method: 前瞻性注册研究，连续纳入2024年2月至2025年3月在本中心接受PFA的房颤患者，随访1年。ERAT定义为90天内持续≥30秒的房颤或房扑；LRAT定义为90天后的复发。采用多变量Cox回归分析ERAT与LRAT的关联，并按ERAT时机（30天、60天切点）和是否心脏复律进行亚组分析及交互检验。
AI.result: 共纳入1608例患者，334例（20.8%）发生ERAT。ERAT组LRAT发生率为68.4%，无ERAT组为20.3%（P<0.001）。多变量Cox分析显示ERAT独立预测LRAT（HR 4.89；95%CI 4.04-5.93；P<0.001）。按30天切点：ERAT≤30天 vs 31-90天的LRAT率分别为70.4% vs 65.5%（P=0.41），调整HR分别为5.40 vs 4.34；按60天切点：≤60天 vs 61-90天的LRAT率分别为68.6% vs 67.1%（P=0.88），调整HR分别为4.91 vs 4.83。ERAT患者中，是否心脏复律的LRAT率相似（73% vs 66.7%，P=0.29）。交互检验均无显著差异（P>0.05）。ERAT组需要心脏复律的比例更高（25.1% vs 7.2%，P<0.001；HR 1.49；95%CI 1.10-2.02；P=0.008）。
AI.conclusion: PFA房颤消融后3个月内任何早期房性心律失常均强烈预测晚期复发，且不受发生时机或是否需要心脏复律影响，提示传统空白期概念不适用于PFA。临床应加强PFA术后早期监测。本研究为单中心前瞻性注册研究，结论需多中心验证。

title: Durability and Safety of Superior Vena Cava Isolation With a Lattice-Tip Pulsed Field Ablation Catheter: Focal Versus Circumferential Lesion Sets
Hybrid Ablation for Patients with Persistent and Long-Standing Persistent Atrial Fibrillation
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most commonly encountered arrhythmia, with a rapidly growing prevalence and significant cost to the global healthcare system. Left untreated, AF progresses over time from paroxysmal AF to persistent AF (perAF) and long-standing persistent AF (LS-perAF). AF is associated with significant mortality and morbidity by increasing the risk of developing cardiomyopathy, heart failure, dementia, stroke and systemic embolization. Endocardial catheter ablation (CA) targeting pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) alone is the most commonly employed treatment strategy for patients undergoing invasive treatment for all forms of AF. Despite technological improvements such as pulsed field ablation (PFA), procedural success rates in preventing AF recurrences in patients with perAF and LS-perAF remain suboptimal. A lack of lesion transmurality gives rise to epicardial–endocardial dissociation, which may contribute to AF recurrences. Hybrid ablation (HA) combines epicardial surgical ablation with endocardial CA. HA leads to greater freedom from AF in advanced AF compared to CA, and while existing data support the safety of HA, HA inherently is more invasive, requires a multidisciplinary approach, and has a 5–7.8% risk of major adverse events. HA is reasonable in patients with symptomatic, drug-refractory perAF or LS-perAF. Future directions include evaluating the role of novel operative technologies in HA.

AI.conclusion: 对于有症状、药物难治的持续性和长程持续性房颤患者，混合消融是合理选择，但因其有创性、需多学科协作且存在主要不良事件风险，应个体化决策；未来需评估新型手术技术在混合消融中的作用。

summary_zh: 心房颤动（AF）是最常见的心律失常，其患病率迅速增长，并给全球医疗保健系统带来巨大成本。若不治疗，AF会随时间从阵发性AF进展为持续性AF（perAF）和长程持续性AF（LS-perAF）。AF通过增加发生心肌病、心力衰竭、痴呆、卒中和系统性栓塞的风险，与显著的死亡率和发病率相关。针对肺静脉隔离（PVI）的心内膜导管消融（CA）是接受侵入性治疗的所有类型AF患者最常用的治疗策略。尽管有脉冲场消融（PFA）等技术进步，但在perAF和LS-perAF患者中预防AF复发的手术成功率仍不理想。透壁性损伤的缺乏导致心外膜-心内膜分离，这可能促成AF复发。混合消融（HA）将心外膜外科消融与心内膜CA相结合。与CA相比，HA在晚期AF中带来更高的无AF生存率，且现有数据支持HA的安全性，但HA本质上更具侵入性，需要多学科方法，并且有5–7.8%的主要不良事件风险。HA对于有症状、药物难治性perAF或LS-perAF患者是合理的。未来方向包括评估新型手术技术在HA中的作用。

title: Efficacy and Safety of Direct Oral Anticoagulants for Stroke Prevention in Korean Patients With Atrial Fibrillation
Evaluation of Warfarin Therapy and Achievement of Target Time in Therapeutic Range in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation at Cardiac Care Center Outpatient Clinic of Dr. Soetomo General Hospital
summary: Warfarin remains an important oral anticoagulant for patients with atrial fibrillation (AF); however, achieving adequate anticoagulation requires appropriate prescribing, individualized dose adjustment, and regular monitoring. This study evaluated warfarin utilization, drug-related problems, and achievement of target time in therapeutic range (TTR) among patients with AF at the Integrated Cardiac Care Center Outpatient Clinic of Dr. Soetomo General Academic Hospital, Surabaya, Indonesia. This retrospective observational study reviewed the medical records of 106 eligible patients who attended the clinic between December 2023 and January 2024. Warfarin indications, dosing practices, international normalized ratio (INR) monitoring intervals, potential drug–drug interactions, and suspected adverse drug reactions were evaluated. TTR was calculated using the Rosendaal linear interpolation method. Appropriate indications for warfarin therapy were identified in 83.96% of patients. Mean concordance with the warfarin dosing algorithm was 43.20%, while 35.48% of 885 INR monitoring events occurred within the recommended monitoring intervals. Sixty-five potential drug–drug interaction events and nine bleeding events classified as Bleeding Academic Research Consortium (BARC) type 2 were documented. The mean TTR was 43.15 ± 25.28%, and only 18.87% of patients achieved a TTR ≥65%. These findings indicate that appropriate indications for warfarin therapy did not consistently correspond to adequate anticoagulation control. Warfarin management should therefore emphasize individualized dose adjustment, timely INR monitoring, and systematic medication review. These findings provide a basis for improving anticoagulation management services; however, the retrospective observational design precludes causal inference.

AI.motivation: 华法林仍是房颤患者重要的口服抗凝药，但需个体化剂量调整和定期监测INR以保障抗凝质量。既往关于华法林利用合理性、药物相关问题及TTR达标情况在印尼人群中的证据有限，本研究旨在评估真实世界中华法林管理质量。
AI.method: 回顾性观察性研究，纳入2023年12月至2024年1月在Dr. Soetomo综合学术医院心脏护理中心门诊就诊的106例房颤患者。评估华法林适应证、剂量实践、INR监测间隔、潜在药物相互作用及可疑不良反应。TTR采用Rosendaal线性插值法计算。主要终点为TTR达标率（TTR≥65%），次要终点包括适应证符合率、剂量算法一致率、INR监测及时性及不良事件。
AI.result: 华法林适应证符合率为83.96%；与剂量算法平均一致率为43.20%；885次INR监测事件中仅35.48%在推荐监测间隔内。记录到65次潜在药物相互作用和9例BARC 2型出血事件。平均TTR为43.15±25.28%，仅18.87%的患者达到TTR≥65%。
AI.conclusion: 房颤患者中华法林适应证符合率较高，但抗凝控制质量不佳，TTR达标率低。临床应加强个体化剂量调整、及时INR监测和系统性用药审查。但回顾性设计无法推断因果关系，结论需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh: 华法林仍是心房颤动（AF）患者重要的口服抗凝药；然而，实现充分抗凝需要适当的处方、个体化剂量调整和定期监测。本研究评估了印度尼西亚泗水Dr. Soetomo综合学术医院综合心脏护理中心门诊部AF患者的华法林使用情况、药物相关问题以及目标治疗范围时间（TTR）的达标情况。这项回顾性观察性研究回顾了2023年12月至2024年1月期间在该门诊就诊的106例合格患者的病历。评估了华法林适应证、给药实践、国际标准化比值（INR）监测间隔、潜在药物-药物相互作用以及可疑药物不良反应。TTR采用Rosendaal线性插值法计算。83.96%的患者确定了华法林治疗的适当适应证。与华法林给药算法的一致率平均为43.20%，而在885次INR监测事件中，35.48%发生在推荐的监测间隔内。记录了65起潜在药物-药物相互作用事件和9起归类为出血学术研究联盟（BARC）2型的出血事件。平均TTR为43.15 ± 25.28%，仅18.87%的患者达到TTR ≥65%。这些发现表明，华法林治疗的适当适应证并不总是与充分的抗凝控制相对应。因此，华法林管理应强调个体化剂量调整、及时INR监测和系统性药物审查。这些发现为改进抗凝管理服务提供了依据；然而，回顾性观察性设计无法进行因果推断。

title: The Role of High-Normal Potassium Levels in the Maintenance of Sinus Rhythm Following Cardiac Surgery in Patients with Persistent Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
HIGHLIGHTS: Potassium Optimization: Maintaining high-normal potassium levels (>4.4 mmol/L) during and after bypass significantly improves the restoration and maintenance of sinus rhythm.High Success Rates: 87% of patients achieved sinus rhythm post-surgery, with 71% remaining stable at 48 hours.Predictors of Failure: A larger left atrial diameter was identified as a primary reason for failed cardioversion and AF recurrence.Improved Recovery: Restoring sinus rhythm led to better hemodynamic stability and significantly reduced the duration of ICU stays.

Atrial fibrillation (AF) is highly prevalent in patients undergoing cardiac surgery, and persistent AF poses significant challenges in postoperative rhythm management. This study investigated whether maintaining high-normal potassium levels (>4.4 mmol/L) during and after cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) enhances SR restoration and stability in patients with persistent AF. A prospective observational study of 245 patients undergoing elective cardiac surgery was conducted, with potassium levels maintained above 4.5 mmol/L during CPB and supplemented postoperatively for 48 hours. Outcomes included SR conversion rates, hemodynamic parameters, and predictors of rhythm stability. Results showed that 87% of patients reverted to SR post-CPB, with 71% maintaining SR at 48 hours. Higher intraoperative potassium levels (mean, 4.54 vs 4.41 mmol/L; P=.02) significantly predicted successful cardioversion, whereas larger left atrial diameter (67.2 vs 53.8 mm; P<.001) correlated with AF persistence. Hemodynamic stability improved in patients with SR, with lower heart rates, higher mean arterial pressures, and reduced ICU stays (52.5 vs 58.8 h; P<.001). The study concludes that maintaining high-normal potassium levels during and after CPB facilitates SR restoration and short-term stability in patients with persistent AF, improving hemodynamics and reducing ICU dependency. Left atrial enlargement remains a key determinant of AF recurrence. These findings support perioperative potassium optimization as a feasible strategy to enhance postoperative outcomes, warranting further multicenter trials for validation.

AI.tldr: 在持续性房颤心脏手术患者中，维持高正常血钾水平（>4.4 mmol/L）可提高术后窦性心律恢复率（87%）和48小时维持率（71%），并缩短ICU停留时间。
AI.motivation: 持续性房颤患者心脏手术后心律管理挑战大，既往证据未明确围术期血钾优化对窦性心律恢复的作用，本研究旨在探讨维持高正常血钾水平是否改善术后窦性心律恢复与稳定性。
AI.method: 前瞻性观察性研究，纳入245例择期心脏手术的持续性房颤患者，体外循环期间维持血钾>4.5 mmol/L并术后补充48小时。终点包括窦性心律转复率、血流动力学参数及心律稳定性预测因素。统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 87%患者体外循环后转复窦性心律，71%在48小时维持。术中较高血钾水平（平均4.54 vs 4.41 mmol/L，P=0.02）显著预测转复成功；较大左房内径（67.2 vs 53.8 mm，P<0.001）与房颤持续相关。窦性心律患者血流动力学更稳定，心率更低、平均动脉压更高，ICU停留时间缩短（52.5 vs 58.8小时，P<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 围术期维持高正常血钾水平可促进持续性房颤患者心脏手术后窦性心律恢复和短期稳定，改善血流动力学并减少ICU依赖；左房扩大仍是房颤复发的关键决定因素。该策略可行，但需多中心试验验证，且摘要未报告统计方法细节。

summary_zh:
亮点：钾优化：在搭桥手术期间和术后维持高正常钾水平（>4.4 mmol/L）可显著改善窦性心律的恢复和维持。高成功率：87%的患者术后恢复窦性心律，71%在48小时时保持稳定。失败预测因素：较大的左心房直径被确定为电复律失败和AF复发的主要原因。改善恢复：恢复窦性心律带来更好的血流动力学稳定性，并显著缩短ICU停留时间。

心房颤动（AF）在接受心脏手术的患者中非常普遍，而持续性AF对术后心律管理构成重大挑战。本研究探讨了在体外循环（CPB）期间和之后维持高正常钾水平（>4.4 mmol/L）是否能增强持续性AF患者的窦性心律（SR）恢复和稳定性。进行了一项前瞻性观察性研究，纳入245例接受择期心脏手术的患者，在CPB期间维持钾水平高于4.5 mmol/L，并在术后补充48小时。结局包括SR转复率、血流动力学参数和心律稳定性的预测因素。结果显示，87%的患者在CPB后转复为SR，71%在48小时时维持SR。较高的术中钾水平（平均4.54 vs 4.41 mmol/L；P=.02）显著预测成功电复律，而较大的左心房直径（67.2 vs 53.8 mm；P<.001）与AF持续相关。SR患者的血流动力学稳定性改善，表现为心率较低、平均动脉压较高，且ICU停留时间缩短（52.5 vs 58.8 h；P<.001）。研究结论认为，在CPB期间和之后维持高正常钾水平有助于持续性AF患者的SR恢复和短期稳定性，改善血流动力学并减少ICU依赖。左心房扩大仍是AF复发的关键决定因素。这些发现支持围术期钾优化作为改善术后结局的可行策略，值得进一步多中心试验验证。

title: Clinical Event Rates and Patient Satisfaction with Generic Rivaroxaban in Atrial Fibrillation: The Prospective Guardian Study.
summary: Background The use of oral anticoagulants (OACs), especially direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs), for thromboprophylaxis in atrial fibrillation (AF) has increased over the last decade, and an increasing number of generic DOAC medications (particularly regarding rivaroxaban and apixaban) have been marketed recently. The aim of the present study was to prospectively observe clinical event rates and patient satisfaction with a generic rivaroxaban for thromboprophylaxis in patients with AF. Methods Adult patients with AF in whom long-term OAC was indicated for thromboprophylaxis were included in this international, prospective, non-interventional, observational study with 1-year follow-up, conducted in the Republic of Serbia and Bosnia and Herzegovina. Data were collected at baseline and 3-, 6-, and 12-month follow-up visits. The primary endpoints were stroke/systemic embolism (SE), major bleeding, and all-cause mortality. Secondary endpoints included adverse events and patient satisfaction with generic rivaroxaban therapy. Results Of 1092 patients (mean age 67.9 ± 9.8, 42.9% female), 72 (6.6%) discontinued the treatment due to different reasons. The mean value of the CHA 2 DS 2 -VASc score (Congestive heart failure, Hypertension, Age > 75 years, Diabetes mellitus, Stroke, Vascular disease, Age 65-74 years, Sex category) and HAS-BLED (Hypertension [uncontrolled], Abnormal renal and/or liver function, Stroke history, Bleeding history, Labile International Normalised Ratio, Elderly [>65 years], Drugs [non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, aspirin]/Alcohol use [>8 drinks per week]) score was 3.15 ± 1.55 and 1.18 ± 0.92, respectively. Overall, seven patients (0.64%) experienced a symptomatic thromboembolic event (two strokes, three transient ischaemic attack, and two SE), and major bleeding occurred in two patients (0.18%). At the 3-, 6- and 12-month follow-up visits, 1068 (97.8%), 1031 (94.4%) and 1014 participants (92.9%), respectively, were still taking generic rivaroxaban. At 3 and 12 months, 1024/1071 patients (95.6%) and 1005/1020 (98.5%), respectively, were very satisfied or satisfied with generic rivaroxaban. Conclusions The observed clinical event rates during the use of generic rivaroxaban in AF patients were low, with very good 1-year persistence to treatment and persistently high level of patient satisfaction with generic rivaroxaban, including those previously taking another OAC. More studies with larger sample size are needed to allow additional analyses of factors associated with specific outcomes, including non-persistence to treatment with generic rivaroxaban.

AI.tldr: 在1092例房颤患者中，使用仿制利伐沙班1年，症状性血栓栓塞事件率0.64%，大出血率0.18%，治疗持续性和患者满意度均较高。
AI.motivation: 过去十年，口服抗凝药尤其是直接口服抗凝药（DOAC）在房颤血栓预防中的应用增加，仿制DOAC（特别是利伐沙班和阿哌沙班）近期大量上市，但缺乏对仿制利伐沙班临床事件率和患者满意度的前瞻性数据。
AI.method: 国际、前瞻性、非干预性观察性研究，在塞尔维亚和波黑进行，纳入1092例有长期口服抗凝指征的成人房颤患者，随访1年，基线及3、6、12个月收集数据。主要终点为卒中/系统性栓塞（SE）、大出血和全因死亡；次要终点包括不良事件和患者对仿制利伐沙班的满意度。
AI.result: 患者平均年龄67.9±9.8岁，女性42.9%，平均CHA2DS2-VASc评分3.15±1.55，HAS-BLED评分1.18±0.92。72例（6.6%）因不同原因停药。7例（0.64%）发生症状性血栓栓塞事件（2例卒中、3例短暂性脑缺血发作、2例SE），2例（0.18%）发生大出血。3、6、12个月时仍服用仿制利伐沙班者分别为1068例（97.8%）、1031例（94.4%）和1014例（92.9%）。3个月和12个月时，非常满意或满意的患者分别为1024/1071例（95.6%）和1005/1020例（98.5%）。

summary_zh: 背景：过去十年中，口服抗凝药（OACs），尤其是直接口服抗凝药（DOACs），在心房颤动（AF）血栓预防中的使用有所增加，并且最近有越来越多的仿制DOAC药物（特别是关于利伐沙班和阿哌沙班）上市。本研究旨在前瞻性观察仿制利伐沙班用于AF患者血栓预防的临床事件发生率和患者满意度。方法：这项国际性、前瞻性、非干预性、观察性研究在塞尔维亚共和国和波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那进行，随访1年，纳入有长期OAC血栓预防指征的成年AF患者。在基线以及3、6和12个月随访时收集数据。主要终点为卒中/系统性栓塞（SE）、大出血和全因死亡率。次要终点包括不良事件和患者对仿制利伐沙班治疗的满意度。结果：1092例患者（平均年龄67.9 ± 9.8岁，42.9%为女性）中，72例（6.6%）因不同原因停止治疗。CHA2DS2-VASc评分（充血性心力衰竭、高血压、年龄>75岁、糖尿病、卒中、血管疾病、年龄65-74岁、性别类别）和HAS-BLED评分（高血压[未控制]、肾功能和/或肝功能异常、卒中史、出血史、国际标准化比值不稳定、老年人[>65岁]、药物[非甾体抗炎药、阿司匹林]/酒精使用[>每周8杯]）的平均值分别为3.15 ± 1.55和1.18 ± 0.92。总体而言，7例患者（0.64%）发生症状性血栓栓塞事件（2例卒中、3例短暂性脑缺血发作和2例SE），2例患者（0.18%）发生大出血。在3、6和12个月随访时，分别有1068例（97.8%）、1031例（94.4%）和1014例参与者（92.9%）仍在服用仿制利伐沙班。在3和12个月时，分别有1024/1071例患者（95.6%）和1005/1020例（98.5%）对仿制利伐沙班非常满意或满意。结论：AF患者使用仿制利伐沙班期间观察到的临床事件发生率较低，1年治疗持续性非常好，患者对仿制利伐沙班的满意度持续较高，包括既往服用另一种OAC的患者。需要更大样本量的更多研究，以便对与特定结局相关的因素进行额外分析，包括对仿制利伐沙班治疗不持续。
