title: From Sudden Cardiac Death Prevention to Performance Optimization: A Conceptual Framework for Cardiovascular Assessment in Elite Athletes
summary: Cardiovascular pre-participation evaluation in elite athletes primarily aims to identify cardiovascular conditions associated with sudden cardiac death. Current international recommendations emphasize comprehensive medical history, physical examination, and resting 12-lead electrocardiography (ECG), with additional investigations guided by clini-cal findings and individual risk. However, advances in sports cardiology, cardiovascular imaging, and exercise physiology provide opportunities to integrate cardiovascular risk assessment with physiological performance evaluation. This article proposes a concep-tual, hypothesis-generating framework integrating structural, electrical, and functional cardiovascular assessment in elite athletes. The framework consists of 3 sequential components: comprehensive clinical assessment with resting ECG; transthoracic echo-cardiography for structural evaluation and longitudinal reference; and cardiopulmonary exercise testing (CPET) as an optional complementary investigation. Cardiopulmonary exercise testing may provide information on maximal oxygen uptake, ventilatory thresh-olds, oxygen pulse, ventilatory efficiency, heart rate recovery, and exercise-induced arrhythmias, potentially supporting individualized training prescription and longitudinal physiological monitoring. Cardiac magnetic resonance and coronary computed tomog-raphy angiography (CCTA) may be considered selectively when clinically indicated. A one-time CCTA strategy during an athlete's career is proposed as a research hypothesis requiring prospective assessment of clinical utility and cost-effectiveness. Importantly, CPET and CCTA are not proposed as universal screening requirements. This framework is intended to complement, rather than replace, current evidence-based international recommendations. As the proposed model is based on available literature and expert opinion and has not undergone prospective clinical validation, future multicenter stud-ies are required to determine whether integrated cardiovascular assessment improves risk stratification, athlete safety, clinical decision-making, performance monitoring, and cost-effectiveness.

title: Value of Left Ventricular Low Voltage Area and Ejection Fraction in Predicting End-Stage Heart Failure Outcomes After Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation in Patients With Non-Ischemic Cardiomyopathy.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Patients with nonischemic cardiomyopathy (NICM) and ventricular tachycardia are at increased risk for adverse HF outcomes, and abnormal left ventricular (LV) substrate identified by endocardial unipolar and bipolar low-voltage areas (LVAs) may aid in risk stratification. This study assessed the association of LV unipolar and bipolar LVAs with end-stage HF outcomes in patients with NICM undergoing ventricular tachycardia ablation.

METHODS: Patients with NICM and LV ejection fraction (EF) <50% undergoing ventricular tachycardia ablation from 2019 to 2023 were included. Endocardial voltage mapping defined confluent (>2 cm2) unipolar LVAs as <8.27 mV and bipolar LVAs as <1.5 mV during sinus or paced rhythm. End-stage HF outcomes included HF death, LV assist device implantation, or heart transplant. Multivariable Cox proportional hazards regression analysis assessed associations between unipolar/bipolar LVAs and end-stage HF outcomes.

RESULTS: One hundred eleven patients with NICM (mean age, 64.6±9.8 years; 81.1% male; mean LVEF, 33.8±11.7%) were included. During a median follow-up of 28.1 months (interquartile range, 18-46), 28 (25.2%) patients experienced end-stage HF outcomes. Unipolar LVA (hazard ratio, 1.03 per 1% increase [95% CI, 1.01-1.05]; P=0.002) and LVEF (hazard ratio, 1.04 per 1% decrease [95% CI, 1.00-1.09]; P=0.03) were independently associated with higher end-stage HF risk, while bipolar LVA was not (hazard ratio, 0.98, 1% increase [95% CI, 0.96-1.01]; P=0.25). A 3-point risk score based on the Youden index, unipolar LVA ≥70% (2 points), 35% to 70% (1 point), and LVEF ≤25% (1 point), had 82.1% sensitivity and 77.1% specificity for predicting end-stage HF in scores ≥2.

CONCLUSIONS: In patients with NICM undergoing ventricular tachycardia ablation, unipolar LVA and LVEF are independent predictors of end-stage HF outcomes. Integrating these predictors yields a prognostic score to identify patients at the highest risk of end-stage HF outcomes.

title: Persistent Supraventricular Tachycardia Following Central Venous Catheter Insertion: When Withdrawal of the Mechanical Stimulus Is Not Enough.
summary: Cardiac arrhythmias are a recognised complication of central venous catheterisation and are usually attributed to mechanical irritation of the endocardium by the guidewire or catheter tip. These arrhythmias typically resolve following withdrawal of the mechanical stimulus. We report a 42-year-old man with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction and diabetic ketoacidosis who developed an abrupt regular narrow-complex tachycardia at approximately 217 beats/min immediately following advancement of a right internal jugular central venous catheter. The arrhythmia was associated with transient hypotension and dizziness and persisted despite removal of both the guidewire and catheter. This case illustrates that catheter manipulation may trigger a sustained supraventricular tachycardia that persists after removal of the mechanical stimulus, particularly in a patient with structural heart disease and metabolic and electrolyte abnormalities. Persistent tachyarrhythmia following catheter withdrawal should prompt assessment of haemodynamic stability and guideline-directed arrhythmia management rather than an assumption of spontaneous resolution.

Bidirectional ventricular tachycardia unmasked by beta-blockade in pheochromocytoma presenting as hypertensive optic neuropathy: a case report and literature review
summary: Background Pheochromocytoma is a catecholamine-secreting neuroendocrine tumor that can produce life-threatening cardiovascular complications. Bidirectional ventricular tachycardia (BVT) is a rare arrhythmia with a narrow differential diagnosis, classically associated with digitalis toxicity and catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, and only exceptionally reported as the presenting feature of pheochromocytoma. Case presentation A 51-year-old woman presented with acute visual impairment secondary to hypertensive optic neuropathy; her blood pressure was 220/138 mmHg. Within 24 h of initiating sodium nitroprusside and metoprolol, she developed bidirectional ventricular tachycardia followed by torsades de pointes. Marked blood-pressure lability, dramatically elevated plasma free metanephrines and catecholamines, and a left adrenal mass on computed tomography established the diagnosis of pheochromocytoma. After alpha-adrenergic blockade with phenoxybenzamine, laparoscopic adrenalectomy was performed, and histopathology confirmed the diagnosis. No ventricular arrhythmia recurred, and blood pressure normalized without antihypertensive medication. Conclusion Bidirectional ventricular tachycardia may be the initial manifestation of pheochromocytoma and may be unmasked by beta-blockade administered before alpha-blockade. Unexplained BVT accompanied by blood-pressure fluctuations should prompt biochemical screening and adrenal imaging. Etiologic treatment is curative, whereas antiarrhythmic therapy alone is insufficient. We review the previously published cases to contextualize this rare phenotype.

title: Multimodality Imaging-Guided Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation in a Hypoplastic Right Ventricle After Glenn Palliation
summary: Adults with single-ventricle physiology increasingly survive into adulthood and may develop complex ventricular arrhythmias. A 44-year-old man with severe right ventricular hypoplasia and previous bidirectional Glenn palliation presented with sustained monomorphic ventricular tachycardia. Transthoracic and intracardiac echocardiography, computed tomography, and high-density electroanatomic mapping were combined to reconstruct the right-sided anatomy and to characterize the arrhythmogenic substrate. Intracardiac echocardiographic contours were merged with the electroanatomic map to build the geometry of the rudimentary right ventricle, in which extensive low-voltage areas were identified, with the latest and most fragmented late potentials confined to the anterior right ventricular outflow tract. Programmed stimulation did not induce ventricular tachycardia; however, pace mapping within the late-potential region reproduced the clinical QRS morphology with a stimulus-to-QRS interval of 153 milliseconds. Ablation was therefore guided by substrate homogenization, and a postablation high-density remap confirmed abolition of all late potentials. A subcutaneous implantable cardioverter-defibrillator was implanted before discharge.

Forensic cause-of-death determination of myocardial infarction-related sudden cardiac death in histopathologically similar cases using computational pathology
summary: Determining whether myocardial infarction-related sudden cardiac death (MI-SCD) is the cause of death remains particularly challenging in forensic practice because different causes of death can produce highly similar myocardial histopathological changes. This study developed a computational pathology framework to support forensic cause-of-death determination by distinguishing MI-SCD from other causes associated with similar myocardial alterations and identifying characteristic myocardial injury patterns associated with MI-SCD. The study included 412H&E-stained whole-slide images (WSIs) of left ventricular myocardium from the GTEx database (221 MI-SCD and 191 control cases) and an independent external validation cohort of 43 slides (18 MI-SCD and 25 control cases). Image features were extracted using the UNI encoder, and slide-level classification was performed using a clustering-constrained attention multiple-instance learning model (CLAM). The UNI-CLAM model achieved area under the curve (AUC) values of 0.895, 0.908, and 0.829 and accuracies of 0.815, 0.824, and 0.790 in the test, validation, and external cohorts, respectively. Beyond classification, attention-guided analysis indicated that the model integrated histopathological information from multiple tissue patterns rather than relying on any single lesion. Subsequent spatial co-localization analysis identified characteristic myocardial injury patterns in MI-SCD, including the frequent co-occurrence of myocardial rupture and degeneration and the close spatial association of myocardial fibrosis with both degeneration and inflammatory cell infiltration. These findings suggest that MI-SCD is characterized by distinctive myocardial injury patterns despite substantial histopathological overlap with other causes of death and may provide a more objective basis for forensic cause-of-death determination.

title: Advanced renal cell carcinoma with extensive venous tumor thrombus: A case report
summary: Background Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) is an aggressive cancer that can invade into the renal vein and inferior vena cava (IVC), rarely with extension into the right atrium resulting in life-threatening complications such as thrombus migration into the pulmonary arteries and sudden cardiac death. Case presentation This is a single patient case report describing a multidisciplinary approach to a 59-year-old Bangladeshi male with type 2 diabetes mellitus and osteoarthritis presenting with progressive fatigue, intermittent left-sided abdominal discomfort, early satiety, a 6-kg unintentional weight loss, mild nausea, and gradually worsening bilateral ankle swelling. An initial investigation revealed moderate normocytic anemia with normal endoscopy and colonoscopy. Further investigations included Ultrasound of the abdomen with Doppler Ultrasonography which demonstrated a large, heterogeneous mass occupying the mid-to-lower pole of the left kidney with distended left renal vein, mild ascites and hepatic vein congestion. A subsequent contrast-enhanced CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis revealed the contiguity of tumor thrombus into the IVC with projection into the right atrium. Transthoracic echocardiography confirmed the diagnosis furthermore. On physical examination, abdomen was distended with left flank tenderness, and a palpable mass in the upper left quadrant. A CT-guided percutaneous biopsy of the renal mass revealed clear cell RCC. Based on clinical and imaging results, we diagnosed the patient as a case of advanced renal cell carcinoma with extensive venous tumor thrombus extending into the right atrium. Due to the advancement of cancer and involvement of the vascular structures, we opted for conservative management with long-term therapeutic anticoagulation and combination immune checkpoint therapy. Conclusion This case highlights the diagnostic strategies of advanced RCC in resource limited settings which facilitates earlier diagnosis and improves outcomes of such cases.

AI.tldr: 一例59岁晚期肾细胞癌伴静脉瘤栓延伸至右心房的患者，因肿瘤进展采取保守抗凝联合免疫检查点治疗。
AI.motivation: 肾细胞癌可侵犯肾静脉和下腔静脉，罕见延伸至右心房，导致瘤栓迁移至肺动脉和心源性猝死等危及生命的并发症。在资源有限地区，早期诊断策略对改善此类病例预后至关重要。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。患者为59岁孟加拉国男性，有2型糖尿病和骨关节炎，表现为进行性疲劳、左侧腹部不适、早饱、6公斤非自愿体重减轻、轻度恶心和双踝水肿。通过腹部超声多普勒、增强CT、经胸超声心动图等影像学检查，以及CT引导下经皮肾肿块活检确诊为晚期肾细胞癌伴广泛静脉瘤栓延伸至右心房。因癌症晚期和血管结构受累，选择保守治疗，包括长期治疗性抗凝和联合免疫检查点治疗。
AI.result: 影像学显示左肾中下极大型不均匀肿块，左肾静脉扩张，瘤栓连续延伸至下腔静脉并突入右心房；活检证实为透明细胞肾细胞癌。摘要未报告具体随访结局或治疗反应数据。
AI.conclusion: 本病例强调了在资源有限环境下晚期肾细胞癌的诊断策略，有助于早期诊断并改善此类病例的预后。对于伴广泛静脉瘤栓的晚期肾细胞癌，多学科评估和个体化保守治疗是可行选择。

summary_zh: 背景：肾细胞癌（RCC）是一种侵袭性癌症，可侵入肾静脉和下腔静脉（IVC），罕见情况下可延伸至右心房，导致危及生命的并发症，如血栓迁移至肺动脉和心源性猝死。病例介绍：这是一例单患者病例报告，描述了对一名59岁孟加拉国男性的多学科处理方法，该患者患有2型糖尿病和骨关节炎，表现为进行性疲劳、间歇性左侧腹部不适、早饱感、6公斤非意愿性体重减轻、轻度恶心和逐渐加重的双侧踝部水肿。初步检查显示中度正细胞性贫血，内镜和结肠镜检查正常。进一步检查包括腹部超声加多普勒超声检查，显示一个大的、不均匀的肿块占据左肾中下极，左肾静脉扩张，轻度腹水和肝静脉淤血。随后的腹部和盆腔增强CT扫描显示肿瘤血栓与IVC相连并突入右心房。经胸超声心动图进一步证实了诊断。体格检查显示腹部膨隆，左侧腹部压痛，左上腹可触及肿块。CT引导下经皮肾肿块活检显示透明细胞RCC。根据临床和影像学结果，我们诊断该患者为晚期肾细胞癌伴广泛静脉肿瘤血栓延伸至右心房。由于癌症进展和血管结构受累，我们选择了保守治疗，包括长期治疗性抗凝和联合免疫检查点治疗。结论：本病例突出了在资源有限环境中晚期RCC的诊断策略，有助于早期诊断并改善此类病例的结局。

title: Delayed left ventricular remodelling in patients with heart failure and reduced ejection fraction: a systematic review.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: Guidelines recommend an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) in patients with heart failure and a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) of 35% or less despite at least 3 months of guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) to reduce the risk of sudden cardiac death (SCD). However, more efficacious contemporary GDMT may be associated with improvements in LVEF beyond 3 months.

METHODS: A systematic review of MEDLINE, Embase, Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature, Cochrane Trials, the Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews and Web of Science was conducted. Studies of patients with an LVEF of 35% or less after at least 3 months of GDMT who were treated with a longer duration of GDMT were included. Risk of bias was evaluated using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale and a narrative synthesis presented. We report rates of LVEF improvement to above the 35% threshold and all-cause mortality after longer-duration GDMT.

RESULTS: Sixteen observational studies met the inclusion criteria. Risk of bias identified in six of these studies was mainly related to adequacy of follow-up. Risk of bias across other domains and in the other studies was low. Four studies reported the temporal change in ICD eligibility. Following 3–6 months additional GDMT, there was an improvement in LVEF to above 35% in 21%–59% of participants. Three studies reported higher proportions of participants with an LVEF above 35% with increasing duration of GDMT. Seven studies reported all-cause mortality, ranging from 0% to 7.6% during follow-up of 6–24 months.

CONCLUSION: In patients with heart failure and an LVEF of 35% or less despite at least 3 months of GDMT, two to six in 10 patients demonstrated an improvement in their LVEF to >35% after a further 3–6 months of GDMT. During this period, mortality rates were low. A longer period of GDMT prior to evaluation for ICD may be appropriate.

PROSPERO REGISTRATION NUMBER: CRD42023390835.

AI.tldr: 在LVEF≤35%且已接受至少3个月GDMT的心衰患者中，继续3-6个月GDMT后21%-59%的患者LVEF改善至35%以上，期间全因死亡率0%-7.6%。
AI.motivation: 指南推荐LVEF≤35%且已接受至少3个月GDMT的心衰患者植入ICD以降低SCD风险，但更有效的当代GDMT可能使LVEF在3个月后继续改善，导致部分患者不再符合ICD指征，而现有证据对延迟重构的幅度和时程尚不明确。
AI.method: 系统综述，检索MEDLINE、Embase、CINAHL、Cochrane Trials、Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews和Web of Science，纳入LVEF≤35%且已接受至少3个月GDMT后继续延长GDMT疗程的观察性研究，采用Newcastle-Ottawa量表评估偏倚风险，叙述性合成，报告LVEF改善至>35%的比例和全因死亡率。
AI.result: 共纳入16项观察性研究，6项研究偏倚风险主要与随访充分性相关，其他领域及其他研究偏倚风险低。4项研究报告ICD资格的时间变化：额外3-6个月GDMT后，21%-59%的参与者LVEF改善至>35%；3项研究显示随GDMT持续时间延长，LVEF>35%的比例更高。7项研究报告全因死亡率，随访6-24个月期间为0%-7.6%。
AI.conclusion: 在LVEF≤35%且已接受至少3个月GDMT的心衰患者中，继续3-6个月GDMT后约2-6/10的患者LVEF改善至>35%，期间死亡率低；在评估ICD前延长GDMT疗程可能是合理的。但证据仅来自观察性研究，存在随访偏倚，需前瞻性研究验证延迟ICD评估策略的安全性。

summary_zh:
目的：指南推荐，对于心力衰竭且左心室射血分数（LVEF）≤35%的患者，在接受至少3个月的指南导向药物治疗（GDMT）后，应植入植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）以降低心脏性猝死（SCD）风险。然而，更有效的当代GDMT可能与LVEF在3个月后的改善相关。

方法：对MEDLINE、Embase、护理与联合健康文献累积索引、Cochrane试验、Cochrane系统评价数据库和Web of Science进行了系统评价。纳入的研究对象为接受至少3个月GDMT后LVEF≤35%、并接受更长时间GDMT治疗的患者。使用纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表评估偏倚风险，并进行叙述性综合。我们报告了更长时间GDMT后LVEF改善至高于35%阈值的发生率以及全因死亡率。

结果：16项观察性研究符合纳入标准。其中6项研究发现的偏倚风险主要与随访的充分性有关。其他领域和其他研究的偏倚风险较低。4项研究报告了ICD资格的时间变化。在额外3-6个月的GDMT后，21%-59%的参与者LVEF改善至高于35%。3项研究报告，随着GDMT持续时间增加，LVEF高于35%的参与者比例更高。7项报告了全因死亡率，在6-24个月的随访期间为0%至7.6%。

结论：在尽管接受至少3个月GDMT但LVEF仍≤35%的心力衰竭患者中，十分之二至十分之六的患者在进一步3-6个月的GDMT后LVEF改善至>35%。在此期间，死亡率较低。在评估ICD之前进行更长时间的GDMT可能是合适的。

title: Upgrading to biventricular pacing or left bundle branch area pacing for the treatment of pacemaker-induced cardiomyopathy
summary: Pacing-induced cardiomyopathy (PiCM) is a recognized consequence of chronic right ventricular pacing and is largely attributed to pacing-related electrical and mechanical dyssynchrony. Device upgrade to biventricular pacing (BiVP) or left bundle branch area pacing (LBBAP) may restore ventricular synchrony and improve cardiac function, yet direct comparative data remain limited. To descriptively evaluate clinical, electrical, and echocardiographic outcomes after upgrading to BiVP-CRT or LBBAP in patients with PiCM and to explore the association between paced QRS narrowing and ventricular recovery. In this single-center retrospective cohort study, 31 patients with symptomatic PiCM underwent device upgrade to BiVP ( n = 16) or LBBAP ( n = 15) between 2014 and 2024. PiCM was defined as an absolute decline in left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) > 10% to < 50% in the setting of right ventricular pacing burden > 20%. Clinical status (NYHA functional class), electrical parameters (paced QRS duration), and echocardiographic indices (LVEF, LVEDD) were evaluated before and after upgrade. A secondary exploratory receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis was performed to assess the association between paced QRS narrowing and LVEF normalization (≥ 50%). During a median follow-up of 10.0 months, device upgrade was associated with significant short-term within-group improvements in functional status, electrical synchrony, and ventricular function in both groups. LVEF increased by 8.44% in the BiVP group and by 6.60% in the LBBAP group, without significant differences between groups ( p = 0.859). No statistically significant between-group differences were observed in NYHA class, paced QRS duration, or LV dimensions; however, the study was not powered for comparative inference. In a secondary exploratory analysis, greater paced QRS narrowing was associated with LVEF normalization; the data-derived ≥ 41-ms threshold was not validated and should be considered preliminary and hypothesis-generating. No major device-related complications were observed. Both BiVP and LBBAP upgrades were associated with favorable short-term improvements in electrical dyssynchrony and ventricular function in patients with PiCM. However, this small, underpowered study was not designed to establish equivalence between the two strategies, and no conclusions regarding their relative efficacy can be drawn. The observed association between paced QRS narrowing and ventricular recovery is preliminary and requires prospective validation. Prospective studies are warranted to define the optimal upgrade strategy in this population.

AI.motivation: 慢性右心室起搏可导致起搏器诱导心肌病（PiCM），其机制主要与起搏相关的电和机械不同步有关。升级为双心室起搏（BiVP）或左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）可能恢复心室同步性并改善心功能，但两种策略的直接比较数据有限。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入2014年至2024年间31例接受器械升级的症状性PiCM患者，其中BiVP组16例，LBBAP组15例。PiCM定义为右心室起搏负荷>20%时左心室射血分数（LVEF）绝对下降>10%且<50%。评估升级前后临床状态（NYHA心功能分级）、电学参数（起搏QRS时限）和超声心动图指标（LVEF、左心室舒张末期内径）。次要探索性分析采用ROC曲线评估起搏QRS时限缩短与LVEF正常化（≥50%）的关联。
AI.result: 中位随访10.0个月，两组升级后短期内心功能、电同步性和心室功能均较基线显著改善。LVEF在BiVP组增加8.44%，在LBBAP组增加6.60%，组间无显著差异（p=0.859）。NYHA分级、起搏QRS时限和左心室尺寸均无显著组间差异，但研究未针对比较性推断进行效能计算。次要探索性分析显示，起搏QRS时限缩短幅度越大与LVEF正常化相关；数据衍生的≥41 ms阈值未经验证，应视为初步和假设生成性结果。未观察到主要器械相关并发症。
AI.conclusion: 在PiCM患者中，升级为BiVP或LBBAP均与短期电不同步和心室功能的有利改善相关。然而，这项样本量小、效能不足的研究并非设计用于确立两种策略的等效性，无法就相对疗效得出结论。起搏QRS时限缩短与心室恢复的关联为初步发现，需前瞻性验证。需要前瞻性研究来定义该人群的最佳升级策略。

summary_zh: 起搏诱导性心肌病（PiCM）是慢性右心室起搏的公认后果，主要归因于起搏相关的电学和机械性不同步。升级为双心室起搏（BiVP）或左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）的器械升级可能恢复心室同步性并改善心脏功能，但直接比较数据仍然有限。旨在描述性评估PiCM患者升级至BiVP-CRT或LBBAP后的临床、电学和超声心动图结果，并探讨起搏QRS波变窄与心室恢复之间的关联。在这项单中心回顾性队列研究中，2014年至2024年间，31例有症状的PiCM患者接受了器械升级至BiVP（n=16）或LBBAP（n=15）。PiCM定义为在右心室起搏负荷>20%的情况下，左心室射血分数（LVEF）绝对下降>10%至<50%。在升级前后评估临床状态（NYHA功能分级）、电学参数（起搏QRS波时限）和超声心动图指标（LVEF、LVEDD）。进行了二次探索性受试者工作特征（ROC）分析，以评估起搏QRS波变窄与LVEF正常化（≥50%）之间的关联。在中位随访10.0个月期间，器械升级与两组在功能状态、电学同步性和心室功能方面的显著短期组内改善相关。BiVP组LVEF增加8.44%，LBBAP组增加6.60%，组间无显著差异（p=0.859）。在NYHA分级、起搏QRS波时限或左心室尺寸方面未观察到统计学显著的组间差异；然而，该研究不足以进行对比推断。在二次探索性分析中，更大的起搏QRS波变窄与LVEF正常化相关；数据衍生的≥41-ms阈值未经验证，应视为初步和假设生成性。未观察到主要器械相关并发症。BiVP和LBBAP升级均与PiCM患者电学不同步和心室功能的有利短期改善相关。然而，这项小型、把握度不足的研究并非旨在确立两种策略之间的等效性，无法就其相对疗效得出任何结论。观察到的起搏QRS波变窄与心室恢复之间的关联是初步的，需要前瞻性验证。需要前瞻性研究来确定该人群的最佳升级策略。

title: Out of sight, not out of risk: laser extraction of a 26-year-old abandoned pacemaker lead guided by multimodal imaging.
Optimal Depolarization Sequence for CRT Patients
summary: Abstract Background Electrical ventricular dyssynchrony is a hallmark of intraventricular conduction disease in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. Although cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) is effective, a proportion of patients with ECG evidenced electrical dyssynchrony remain non-responders. Besides the QRS duration, visualization and quantification of the depolarization sequence could contribute to improving CRT response. Objective The study aimed to evaluate the CineECG-derived mean temporo-spatial isochrone trajectory of depolarization in CRT patients. Methods Among the adult cohort of 121 patients who underwent CRT implantation, there were 93 (33% female) responders and 28 (7% female) non-responders. ECGs recorded before and immediately after CRT implantation were collected and analyzed using the CineECG modality with a generic heart/torso model. The CineECG-derived path directions were computed for the QRS on anteroposterior, interventricular, and apicobasal axes within the cardiac anatomy. Spatial depolarization characteristics were tested for the association with left ventricle reverse-remodeling at six-month follow-up. Results The pre-implantation depolarization sequence was predominantly from the right to the left ventricle, and after the CRT implant, it has been transformed into an apicobasal direction. In multivariate logistic regression, the pre-implant QRS duration, apicobasal depolarization gradient, and CRT-induced QRS shortening independently predicted CRT response. The Akaike information criterion indicated that combining all three yielded the strongest predictive model. Conclusion CineECG-derived depolarization gradients, which reflect ventricular activation sequence, changed significantly after CRT, and the pre-implantation apicobasal gradient independently predicted echocardiographic outcome, with a less pronounced gradient associated with better hemodynamic response.

AI.tldr: 在121例CRT患者中，CineECG衍生的植入前心尖-基底去极化梯度可独立预测CRT反应，梯度越小反应越好。
AI.motivation: CRT是伴电学不同步的心衰患者的重要治疗，但部分患者即使ECG显示QRS增宽仍无反应。除QRS时限外，去极化序列的可视化与量化可能有助于提高CRT反应预测。
AI.method: 回顾性分析121例成人CRT植入患者（93例反应者，28例无反应者），收集植入前后ECG，用CineECG通用心/躯干模型计算QRS在前后、室间、心尖-基底轴上的路径方向，以6个月随访左室逆重构为终点，多因素logistic回归分析空间去极化特征与CRT反应的关系。
AI.result: 植入前去极化序列主要从右室向左室，植入后转为心尖-基底方向。多因素logistic回归显示，植入前QRS时限、心尖-基底去极化梯度和CRT诱导的QRS缩短独立预测CRT反应；AIC表明三者联合模型预测能力最强。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: CineECG衍生的去极化梯度反映心室激动顺序，CRT后显著改变，植入前心尖-基底梯度可独立预测超声心动图逆重构，梯度较小与更好的血流动力学反应相关。该指标有望辅助CRT患者筛选，但需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh:
背景：心室电学不同步是射血分数降低的心力衰竭中室内传导疾病的标志。尽管心脏再同步治疗（CRT）有效，但一部分心电图证实存在电学不同步的患者仍然无应答。除了QRS时限外，可视化与量化去极化序列可能有助于改善CRT应答。

目的：本研究旨在评估CRT患者中CineECG衍生的去极化平均时空等时线轨迹。

方法：在121例接受CRT植入的成年患者队列中，有93例（33%女性）应答者和28例（7%女性）无应答者。收集CRT植入前和植入后即刻记录的心电图，并使用CineECG模式结合通用心脏/躯干模型进行分析。在心脏解剖结构内，针对前-后、心室间和心尖-基底轴上的QRS计算CineECG衍生的路径方向。测试空间去极化特征与六个月随访时左心室逆重构的相关性。

结果：植入前的去极化序列主要从右心室到左心室，CRT植入后转变为心尖-基底方向。在多变量逻辑回归中，植入前QRS时限、心尖-基底去极化梯度和CRT诱导的QRS缩短独立预测CRT应答。赤池信息准则表明，结合所有三个变量产生了最强的预测模型。

结论：反映心室激动序列的CineECG衍生去极化梯度在CRT后发生显著变化，且植入前心尖-基底梯度独立预测超声心动图结局，梯度越不明显与更好的血流动力学应答相关。

title: Appropriate ICD Therapies in Primary Prevention: A Propensity-Matched Comparison of Contemporary and Historic Heart Failure Cohorts
summary: Background In heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), a substantial proportion of deaths are arrhythmic. Implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs) are recommended for primary prevention in patients with left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≤ 35% despite guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT), but landmark trials predate widespread use of angiotensin receptor-neprilysin inhibitors (ARNI) and sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i), raising uncertainty about arrhythmic risk in the contemporary treatment era.Methods We retrospectively studied consecutive HFrEF patients undergoing primary-prevention ICD implantation at a single center (2015-2022), categorized into historical-era and contemporary-era cohorts by ARNI/SGLT2i adoption. Propensity-score matching balanced baseline characteristics. The primary endpoint was time to first appropriate ICD therapy (antitachycardia pacing or shock).Results Of 289 patients (mean age 62 ± 11 years, 82% male), 234 (117 per group) remained after matching. Mean follow-up was 51 months. Appropriate ICD therapy incidence did not differ significantly between contemporary-era and historical-era cohorts (hazard ratio [HR] 1.52, 95% CI 0.84-2.72; p = 0.165). Competing-risk-adjusted cumulative incidence was numerically higher in the contemporary-era cohort at a pre-specified 36-months horizon, consistent with a sensitivity analysis using an expanded propensity-score model (HR 1.55, 95% CI 0.82-2.94).Conclusion ICD therapy rates were not significantly different between the contemporary-era and historical-era cohorts, a finding robust to sensitivity and competing-risk analyses. These results should be interpreted cautiously, as the study may be underpowered to detect modest differences, and clinically relevant effects cannot be excluded.

AI.tldr: 在HFrEF一级预防ICD患者中，当代ARNI/SGLT2i治疗时代与历史队列的恰当ICD治疗发生率无显著差异（HR 1.52，95%CI 0.84-2.72，P=0.165）。
AI.motivation: HFrEF患者中相当比例死亡为心律失常性，ICD被推荐用于LVEF≤35%且接受GDMT患者的一级预防，但既往里程碑试验早于ARNI和SGLT2i的广泛应用，当代治疗时代心律失常风险是否变化尚不明确。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入2015-2022年连续接受一级预防ICD植入的HFrEF患者，按ARNI/SGLT2i采用情况分为历史队列和当代队列，采用倾向性评分匹配平衡基线特征。主要终点为首次恰当ICD治疗（抗心动过速起搏或电击）时间。
AI.result: 共289例患者（平均年龄62±11岁，82%男性），匹配后234例（每组117例），平均随访51个月。当代队列与历史队列的恰当ICD治疗发生率无显著差异（HR 1.52，95%CI 0.84-2.72；P=0.165）。竞争风险校正的36个月累积发生率在当代队列数值上更高，与扩展倾向评分模型的敏感性分析一致（HR 1.55，95%CI 0.82-2.94）。
AI.conclusion: 当代与历史队列的ICD治疗率无显著差异，结果在敏感性和竞争风险分析中稳健。但研究可能把握度不足，不能排除临床相关差异，需谨慎解读；对当代GDMT时代一级预防ICD患者的选择与风险评估具有参考意义。

summary_zh:
背景：在射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）中，相当比例的死因为心律失常性。植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）被推荐用于左心室射血分数（LVEF）≤ 35% 且已接受指南指导的药物治疗（GDMT）患者的初级预防，但里程碑式试验早于血管紧张素受体脑啡肽酶抑制剂（ARNI）和钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2抑制剂（SGLT2i）的广泛使用，这增加了当代治疗时代心律失常风险的不确定性。

方法：我们回顾性研究了单中心（2015-2022）连续接受初级预防ICD植入的HFrEF患者，根据ARNI/SGLT2i的采用情况分为历史时代队列和当代队列。倾向性评分匹配平衡了基线特征。主要终点是首次适当ICD治疗（抗心动过速起搏或电击）的时间。

结果：在289例患者（平均年龄62 ± 11岁，82%为男性）中，匹配后剩余234例（每组117例）。平均随访时间为51个月。当代队列与历史队列之间适当ICD治疗的发生率无显著差异（风险比[HR] 1.52，95% CI 0.84-2.72；p = 0.165）。在预先指定的36个月时间点，竞争风险调整后的累积发生率在当代队列中数值上更高，这与使用扩展倾向性评分模型的敏感性分析一致（HR 1.55，95% CI 0.82-2.94）。

结论：当代队列与历史队列之间的ICD治疗率无显著差异，这一发现对敏感性和竞争风险分析均稳健。这些结果应谨慎解读，因为该研究可能不足以检测适度差异，且不能排除临床相关效应。

title: From Sensing to Authority: A Consequence-Sensitive Architecture for Pacemaker Inhibition Under Uncertain Signal Origin
summary: Pacemaker oversensing matters because a sensed electrical event can be treated as a heartbeat and can thereby withhold pacing. Existing devices already do more than compare a voltage with a threshold. They filter, blank, impose refractory periods, and, under repetitive nonphysiologic signals, often revert to asynchronous pacing. The open problem is not the absence of any noise response. It is that detection, attribution of origin, inhibit relevance, and authority to withhold pacing are still too easily collapsed, and that the collapse is difficult to inspect. This note proposes an action architecture rather than a better heartbeat classifier. A detected event may be evidence. It does not establish origin, and origin does not establish that the event is inhibit-relevant under the present device state. Neither origin nor inhibit relevance, by itself, authorizes withholding a pace. An unresolved origin is not a failure of the whole decision, and it is not a source. It is also not, by itself, an unresolved therapy question. It constrains the action. It does not erase the need to act. If no action meets the safety constraints, a predefined fallback still has to pace or inhibit; recording that failure is not a therapy. The first empirical object is a retrospective, inspectable policy comparison, not a modification of an implant. The note does not claim that this architecture has improved any implanted device. Version 1.0, October 2026. Pre-results methodological paper. The comparison is specified. No implanted device is modified, and no performance claim is made. The action is a triple: the immediate output, the mode transition, and the record. Noise response does not leave the scheduled output unnamed. Origin is a physical source. Inhibit relevance is a protocol-defined target. Uncertainty about one is not uncertainty about the other. Every compared policy sees the same candidate set, and episode-level pause consequences are reported with the per-event rates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于后果敏感性的起搏抑制决策架构，将事件检测、来源归因、抑制相关性和抑制权限分层处理，并计划通过回顾性政策比较进行验证，但尚未报告任何实证数据。
AI.motivation: 起搏器过感知可导致不恰当抑制起搏，现有设备虽具备滤波、空白期、不应期及噪声反转等机制，但检测、来源归因、抑制相关性与抑制权限常被混为一谈且难以审查，临床需要更清晰可审查的决策架构。
AI.method: 方法学论文（预结果），提出一种动作架构而非改进心跳分类器；核心是将检测事件视为证据而非来源或抑制依据，明确来源与抑制相关性为不同概念，并定义动作三元组（即时输出、模式转换、记录）；计划开展回顾性、可审查的政策比较，所有比较策略使用相同候选集，报告 episode 级暂停后果与每事件率；未修改任何植入设备，未报告样本量、终点及统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何实证结果、效应量、置信区间或 P 值；仅描述架构原则：未解决来源不构成整体决策失败或治疗问题，但约束行动；若无行动满足安全约束，预定义后备方案仍须起搏或抑制，记录失败不等于治疗。
AI.conclusion: 该架构强调起搏抑制决策需区分证据、来源、抑制相关性与权限，并保留可审查记录，可能为器械算法设计与监管评价提供框架；但尚未在植入设备中验证，无性能声明，临床影响待实证研究。

summary_zh: 起搏器过感知之所以重要，是因为感知到的心电事件可能被当作一次心跳，从而抑制起搏发放。现有设备所做的已不止是将电压与阈值进行比较。它们会进行滤波、空白处理、设置不应期，并且在出现重复的非生理性信号时，常常转为非同步起搏。尚未解决的问题并不是缺乏任何噪声响应。问题在于，检测、来源归属、抑制相关性以及抑制起搏的权限仍太容易被混为一谈，而且这种混同难以被审查。本短文提出一种行动架构，而非一种更好的心跳分类器。检测到的事件可以成为证据。它并不确立来源，而来源也并不确立该事件在当前设备状态下具有抑制相关性。无论是来源还是抑制相关性，其本身都不授权抑制一次起搏。未解决的来源问题不是整个决策的失败，也不是一个来源。它本身也不是一个未解决的治疗问题。它约束行动。它并不消除行动的必要性。如果没有行动能满足安全约束，预定义的兜底方案仍必须起搏或抑制；记录该失败并不是治疗。第一个实证对象是回顾性的、可审查的策略比较，而不是对植入装置的修改。本短文并不声称该架构已改进任何植入设备。版本1.0，2026年10月。结果前方法学论文。比较方案已明确。不修改任何植入设备，也不作出性能声明。行动是一个三元组：即时输出、模式转换和记录。噪声响应不会使预定输出未被命名。来源是物理源。抑制相关性是方案定义的目标。对其中一个的不确定性并非对另一个的不确定性。每个被比较的策略看到相同的候选集，并且按事件率报告发作级别的暂停后果。

title: Attractive and repulsive couplings between circadian pacemaker neurons promote entrainment to light-dark cycles with after-effect.
summary: The mammalian circadian pacemaker, the suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN), comprises a core region that receives light signals from the retina and a shell region that outputs pacemaking rhythms to peripheral tissues. The free-running period (FRP) of animals in constant darkness (DD) correlates with the period of the preceding LD cycle, a phenomenon known as after-effect. To elucidate the mechanisms underlying robust entrainment and after-effect, we analyzed phase oscillator models incorporating attractive and repulsive couplings that respectively decrease or increase phase differences between oscillators. Attractive coupling from the core to shell regions accounts for experimentally observed phase relationships between these regions under LD cycles. Remarkably, repulsive coupling from the shell to core regions promotes SCN entrainability to LD cycles. Furthermore, after transfer to DD, the FRP slowly returns to the intrinsic SCN period, reflecting the after-effect. Our analysis identifies an SCN coupling architecture that underlies stable daily activity rhythms.

AI.tldr: 视交叉上核核心-壳区之间吸引性与排斥性耦合的相位振子模型可解释光暗周期同步及撤光后自由运行周期缓慢回归的内在机制。
AI.motivation: 哺乳动物昼夜节律起搏器视交叉上核（SCN）由接收视网膜光信号的核心区与向外周输出节律的壳区组成，动物在持续黑暗（DD）中的自由运行周期（FRP）与前一个光暗（LD）周期相关，称为后效应（after-effect）。既往对SCN各区如何耦合以实现稳健同步及后效应的机制尚不清楚，本研究旨在阐明该机制。
AI.method: 本研究为计算/理论建模研究，非临床人体或动物实验，摘要未报告样本量。作者构建相位振子模型，纳入吸引性耦合（减小振子间相位差）与排斥性耦合（增大相位差），分别模拟核心→壳区与壳区→核心的相互作用，并与LD周期下实验观察到的核心-壳区相位关系进行比对，分析SCN对LD周期的同步能力及转入DD后FRP的变化。
AI.result: 核心→壳区的吸引性耦合可复现实验中LD周期下核心与壳区的相位关系；壳区→核心的排斥性耦合可增强SCN对LD周期的同步能力；转入DD后，FRP缓慢回归至SCN内在周期，体现后效应。摘要未报告效应量、95%置信区间或P值等具体统计数值。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出一种SCN耦合架构（核心→壳区吸引性耦合与壳区→核心排斥性耦合并存），可解释稳定的每日活动节律及后效应。该结果为理解昼夜节律同步机制提供理论框架，但属模型研究，尚需实验验证，对电生理临床实践无直接影响。

summary_zh: 哺乳动物昼夜节律起搏器——视交叉上核（SCN）——由接收视网膜光信号的核心区和向外周组织输出起搏节律的壳区组成。动物在持续黑暗（DD）条件下的自由运行周期（FRP）与前一个LD周期的周期相关，这一现象称为后效应。为阐明稳健同步和后效应背后的机制，我们分析了包含吸引性和排斥性耦合的相位振荡器模型，这两种耦合分别减小或增大振荡器之间的相位差。从核心区到壳区的吸引性耦合解释了LD周期下实验观察到的这两个区域之间的相位关系。值得注意的是，从壳区到核心区的排斥性耦合增强了SCN对LD周期的同步能力。此外，在转移到DD后，FRP缓慢恢复到SCN的固有周期，反映了后效应。我们的分析确定了一种支撑稳定日常活动节律的SCN耦合架构。

title: Cardiac Magnetic Resonance-derived Ablation Footprint after Sequential Unipolar Radiofrequency, Focal Pulsed Field, and Bipolar Radiofrequency Ablation of Resistant Left Ventricular Summit VT.
CADENCE: Open-source software for signal conditioning, feature extraction, visualization and analysis of cardiac optical mapping data
summary: ABSTRACT Optical mapping is a fundamental tool for cardiac electrophysiology research. Processing of these signals can be non-trivial, requiring multiple pre- and post-processing steps to limit interpretation errors. Existing software packages have features siloed across platforms and require users to combine several packages for in-depth analysis. To address this, we developed CADENCE, an open-source MATLAB-based application combining feature breadth (e.g., SVD denoising, conduction velocity, alternans, annotated rotors) and depth (e.g., 15 independent alternans features across both voltage and calcium modalities) in an end-to-end pipeline including data conversion, signal conditioning, feature extraction, and signal analysis. We demonstrate CADENCE’s capabilities across datasets spanning four species (rat, rabbit, pig, and human), three tissue preparations (slices, wedge, and whole heart), and three camera configurations (single, dual, and panoramic). CADENCE was validated against three blinded expert observers (15 hearts) and demonstrated agreement comparable to inter-observer variability (SD ratios 1.07/0.95/0.89 for APD80, activation, CaTD80). Dominant frequency was recovered with a median error of 0.03% across 84 of 88 paced recordings with 1:1 capture. CADENCE’s code is publicly available and distributed as a compiled standalone application that the end-user can install and run without a MATLAB license to encourage adoption and standardization across laboratories.

AI.tldr: CADENCE是一款开源MATLAB软件，整合了光学标测数据的信号处理、特征提取与可视化全流程，在四物种、三组织制备和三种相机配置中验证，与专家观察者间一致性相当，可促进实验室标准化。
AI.motivation: 光学标测是心脏电生理研究的基础工具，但信号处理复杂，需多步骤预处理和后处理以减少解读误差。现有软件功能分散于不同平台，用户需组合多个软件包才能深入分析，缺乏端到端解决方案。
AI.method: 开发CADENCE，基于MATLAB的开源应用，整合数据转换、信号调理、特征提取和信号分析全流程，具备广度（如SVD去噪、传导速度、交替、标注转子）和深度（电压和钙 modality 的15个独立交替特征）。在四个物种（大鼠、兔、猪、人）、三种组织制备（切片、楔形、全心脏）和三种相机配置（单、双、全景）的数据集上展示能力。验证：与三位盲法专家观察者（15颗心脏）比较，评估APD80、激活时间、CaTD80的 agreement；在84/88个1:1夺获的起搏记录中评估主频恢复误差。
AI.result: 与专家观察者间变异性相比，CADENCE的SD比值分别为APD80 1.07、激活 0.95、CaTD80 0.89，一致性相当。主频恢复中位误差为0.03%（84/88个1:1夺获起搏记录）。
AI.conclusion: CADENCE作为开源、可独立运行的软件，实现了光学标测数据的端到端分析，与专家观察者间一致性相当，主频恢复准确，有望促进实验室间的采用和标准化。摘要未报告临床结局或局限性。

summary_zh: 摘要 光学标测是心脏电生理研究的基础工具。这些信号的处理可能并不简单，需要多个预处理和后处理步骤来限制解读错误。现有的软件包功能分散在不同平台，需要用户组合多个软件包进行深入分析。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了CADENCE，一个基于MATLAB的开源应用程序，在端到端流程中结合了功能广度（例如，SVD去噪、传导速度、交替、标注转子）和深度（例如，电压和钙两种模态的15个独立交替特征），包括数据转换、信号调理、特征提取和信号分析。我们在涵盖四个物种（大鼠、兔、猪和人）、三种组织制备（切片、楔形和全心脏）和三种相机配置（单、双和全景）的数据集上展示了CADENCE的能力。CADENCE针对三位盲法专家观察者（15颗心脏）进行了验证，并表现出与观察者间变异性相当的一致性（APD80、激活、CaTD80的SD比值分别为1.07/0.95/0.89）。在88个1:1捕获的起搏记录中的84个中，主频恢复的中位误差为0.03%。CADENCE的代码公开可用，并作为编译的独立应用程序分发，最终用户无需MATLAB许可证即可安装和运行，以鼓励各实验室的采用和标准化。

title: Towards a suitable biomarker for childhood screening for familial hypercholesterolemia: a systematic literature review.
summary: Familial hypercholesterolemia (FH) is a common genetic disorder causing elevated low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-c) concentrations from birth, resulting in a high risk of premature cardiovascular disease. Despite effective early treatment, FH remains underdiagnosed in children, highlighting the need for universal screening. This systematic review aims to evaluate the available evidence regarding suitable biomarkers for the purpose of universal screening for FH in childhood. The electronic databases Medline and Embase were systematically searched for studies comparing blood biomarkers in children with heterozygous FH and non-FH children. Of the 2,488 studies found, 35 were included. Although the data were constrained by considerable heterogeneity, LDL-c, total cholesterol (TC), and apolipoprotein B (ApoB) concentrations were consistently higher in children with FH across the included studies. Furthermore, increased non-high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (non-HDL-c), lathosterol, sitosterol and TC/HDL-c ratio, and a decreased squalene/TC ratio were found in children with FH. Only three screening studies combined biomarker (LDL-c, non-HDL-c and TC) and genetic testing simultaneously, revealing however limited sensitivity and specificity of these markers for FH screening in children. In this review, several biomarkers for FH screening in children were evaluated. As sensitivity and specificity data were generally not available or suboptimal, additional studies are needed to evaluate the screening performance of selected biomarkers in well-defined pediatric populations of suitable age and sex distribution, using valid analytical methods, and taking into account possible confounding factors. It is only through such studies that a well-considered selection of biomarkers can be made for the purpose of childhood screening for FH.

AI.tldr: 系统综述纳入35项研究，LDL-c、TC和ApoB在杂合性FH儿童中持续升高，但仅3项筛查研究同时结合生物标志物与基因检测，敏感性和特异性有限或未报告。
AI.motivation: 家族性高胆固醇血症（FH）是常见遗传病，自出生起LDL-c升高，早发心血管病风险高；尽管早期治疗有效，儿童FH仍普遍漏诊，亟需开展普筛，但适合儿童普筛的生物标志物证据尚不明确。
AI.method: 系统综述，检索Medline和Embase，纳入比较杂合性FH儿童与非FH儿童血液生物标志物的研究；共检出2,488项研究，最终纳入35项；主要比较LDL-c、TC、ApoB、非HDL-c、lathosterol、sitosterol、TC/HDL-c比值及squalene/TC比值等指标，并评估同时结合生物标志物与基因检测的筛查研究；摘要未报告具体合并统计方法。
AI.result: 数据异质性较大；LDL-c、TC和ApoB在FH儿童中持续升高，非HDL-c、lathosterol、sitosterol及TC/HDL-c比值升高，squalene/TC比值降低；仅3项筛查研究同时结合生物标志物（LDL-c、非HDL-c、TC）与基因检测，显示这些标志物用于儿童FH筛查的敏感性和特异性有限；摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: 现有生物标志物用于儿童FH普筛的敏感性和特异性数据多缺失或欠佳，尚不足以支持明确选择；需在年龄与性别分布合适、定义明确的人群中，采用有效检测方法并控制混杂因素，进一步评估候选标志物的筛查效能，才能为儿童FH普筛提供依据。

summary_zh: 家族性高胆固醇血症（FH）是一种常见的遗传性疾病，自出生起即导致低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-c）浓度升高，从而带来早发心血管疾病的高风险。尽管早期治疗有效，但FH在儿童中仍诊断不足，凸显了普遍筛查的必要性。本系统综述旨在评估关于适用于儿童FH普遍筛查的合适生物标志物的现有证据。系统检索了电子数据库Medline和Embase，寻找比较杂合子FH儿童与非FH儿童血液生物标志物的研究。在找到的2,488项研究中，共纳入35项。尽管数据因相当大的异质性而受限，但在纳入的研究中，FH儿童的LDL-c、总胆固醇（TC）和载脂蛋白B（ApoB）浓度一致较高。此外，在FH儿童中发现非高密度脂蛋白胆固醇（非HDL-c）、lathosterol、sitosterol和TC/HDL-c比值升高，以及squalene/TC比值降低。只有三项筛查研究同时结合了生物标志物（LDL-c、非HDL-c和TC）和基因检测，然而这些标志物在儿童FH筛查中的敏感性和特异性有限。在本综述中，评估了用于儿童FH筛查的几种生物标志物。由于敏感性和特异性数据通常不可用或欠佳，需要额外研究来评估所选生物标志物在年龄和性别分布合适的明确儿科人群中的筛查性能，使用有效的分析方法，并考虑可能的混杂因素。只有通过此类研究，才能为儿童FH筛查目的做出深思熟虑的生物标志物选择。

title: Supplemental Material for: “I Don’t Think It Is Fair…There Should be a Solution to Every Problem”: Experiences of Individuals with Sudden Arrhythmia Death Syndromes Who Attempt to Obtain Life Insurance
summary: IntroductionSudden Arrhythmia Death Syndromes are a group of heritable genetic conditions that confer risk of sudden cardiac arrest or sudden cardiac death (SCA/SCD) in young, seemingly healthy individuals. Appropriate diagnosis of an SCA/SCD condition allows for guided management and prevents future sudden cardiac arrest and/or death from occurring. However, identification of a genetic predisposition can affect future insurance applications. While the United States’ 2008 Genetic Information Non-discrimination Act (GINA) provides protection against genetic discrimination in employment and health insurance, it does not protect against the use of genetic information with regards to life insurance. This study aimed to expand the current understanding of life insurance experiences in the hereditary SCA/SCD community, gather strategies for individuals who wish to attain life insurance, and facilitate the development of life insurance specific patient and provider resources. MethodsParticipants were recruited through The Sudden Arrhythmia Death Syndromes (SADS) Foundation. Semi-structured interviews were completed with 15 participants who have or are at-risk for SCA/SCD. ResultsThematic analysis captured three themes: Emotional Outlook and Impact, Navigating the System, and Pay It Forward. Our participants with or at-risk for SCA/SCD expressed interest in attaining life insurance coverage that meets their individual needs and invested a meaningful amount of time and effort into their attempts. Most were unsuccessful. ConclusionThey perceived a lack of understanding regarding heritable SCA/SCD conditions by insurance professionals and felt their denials were unfairly attributed to their SCA/SCD diagnosis. Participants shared numerous suggestions for improved approaches to life insurance attainment and educational opportunities.

AI.tldr: 遗传性心律失常性猝死综合征患者或高危者尝试获取寿险时多数失败，认为保险专业人员缺乏对疾病的理解，拒绝不公平。
AI.motivation: 遗传性心律失常性猝死综合征（SADS）是一组可导致年轻看似健康个体发生心脏骤停或猝死的遗传性疾病，明确诊断有助于管理和预防，但基因易感性的识别可能影响寿险申请。美国2008年遗传信息非歧视法案（GINA）仅保护就业和健康保险，不涵盖寿险，因此需要了解该人群的寿险经历以开发针对性资源。
AI.method: 通过SADS基金会招募15名确诊或高危SADS个体，进行半结构化访谈，采用主题分析法分析访谈内容。
AI.result: 分析提炼出三个主题：情绪观感与影响、系统导航、回馈他人。参与者均希望获得满足个人需求的寿险，并投入大量时间精力尝试，但多数未成功；他们认为保险专业人员对遗传性SADS缺乏理解，并将拒保不公平地归因于SADS诊断。摘要未报告具体效应量或P值。
AI.conclusion: SADS患者或高危者在获取寿险时面临困难，感知到保险业对疾病认知不足，并认为拒保不公平；参与者提出了改进寿险获取途径和教育机会的建议。临床意义在于提示电生理从业者需关注患者寿险障碍，并开发患者和提供者资源，但研究为质性小样本，结果外推需谨慎。

summary_zh:
引言
突发性心律失常死亡综合征是一组遗传性遗传疾病，使年轻且看似健康的个体面临心脏骤停或心源性猝死（SCA/SCD）的风险。对SCA/SCD病症的适当诊断可以实现指导性管理，并预防未来发生心脏骤停和/或死亡。然而，识别遗传易感性可能影响未来的保险申请。虽然美国2008年的《遗传信息非歧视法案》（GINA）提供了在就业和健康保险方面免受遗传歧视的保护，但它并不保护在人寿保险方面使用遗传信息。本研究旨在扩展当前对遗传性SCA/SCD社区人寿保险体验的理解，收集希望获得人寿保险的个体的策略，并促进针对人寿保险的患者和提供者资源的开发。

方法
参与者通过突发性心律失常死亡综合征（SADS）基金会招募。对15名患有或面临SCA/SCD风险的参与者完成了半结构化访谈。

结果
主题分析提炼出三个主题：情绪展望与影响、系统导航和回馈。我们患有或面临SCA/SCD风险的参与者表示有兴趣获得满足其个人需求的人寿保险覆盖，并在尝试中投入了大量时间和精力。大多数人未成功。

结论
他们认为保险专业人员对遗传性SCA/SCD病症缺乏了解，并觉得他们的拒保被不公平地归因于他们的SCA/SCD诊断。参与者分享了许多关于改进人寿保险获得方法和教育机会的建议。

title: Histone lysine demethylase inhibition is a disease-modifying therapy for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
summary:
RATIONALE: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is a common inherited cardiac disorder characterized by cardiac hypertrophy, fibrosis, arrhythmias, and sudden cardiac death (SCD). Although current therapies primarily target sarcomere dysfunction, the contribution of epigenetic dysregulation to HCM pathogenesis and its therapeutic potential remain poorly understood.

OBJECTIVE: To determine whether pharmacological inhibition of histone lysine demethylases (KDMs) with JIB-04 can prevent or reverse HCM progression and to identify the underlying epigenetic mechanisms.

METHODS AND RESULTS: We evaluated the pan-KDM inhibitor JIB-04 in Myh6 R403Q/+ mice carrying the murine equivalent of the pathogenic human MYH7 R403Q mutation. JIB-04 prevented disease progression, reduced cardiac hypertrophy and fibrosis, preserved cardiac function, and completely prevented SCD in cyclosporin A- accelerated HCM. JIB-04 also reversed established disease, produced sustained therapeutic benefits after drug withdrawal, and improved cardiac function in aged mice with spontaneous HCM. Bulk RNA sequencing and ATAC-seq demonstrated partial restoration of disease-associated transcriptional programs and chromatin accessibility. Proteomic analyses identified PHF2 (KDM7C) as a candidate target of JIB-04 in both mouse and human HCM hearts. PHF2 knockdown suppressed hypertrophic, inflammatory, and fibrotic gene expression in cardiomyocytes, macrophages, and fibroblasts, respectively. Human HCM hearts exhibited increased expression of multiple JIB-04-sensitive KDMs, including PHF2. In MYH7 R403Q induced pluripotent stem cell- derived cardiomyocytes, JIB-04 normalized disease-associated gene expression, restored connexin-43 membrane localization, and improved mitochondrial respiration. Although prolonged treatment induced reversible hepatomegaly with hepatic lipid accumulation, co-administration of the antioxidant N-acetylcysteine mitigated liver toxicity while preserving the therapeutic efficacy of JIB-04.

CONCLUSIONS: Pharmacological KDM inhibition prevents and reverses HCM through epigenetic remodeling of disease-associated transcriptional and chromatin programs. These findings identify KDM inhibition as a promising therapeutic strategy for HCM, establish PHF2 as a candidate mediator of disease pathogenesis, and support further development of KDM-targeted therapies.

AI.tldr: 泛KDM抑制剂JIB-04在Myh6 R403Q/+小鼠中可预防并逆转肥厚型心肌病，减少心肌肥厚和纤维化，完全预防心源性猝死，其作用与表观遗传重塑及靶点PHF2相关。
AI.motivation: 肥厚型心肌病（HCM）是常见遗传性心脏病，可致心律失常和心源性猝死，现有治疗主要针对肌节功能障碍，表观遗传失调在HCM发病中的作用及治疗潜力尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在携带Myh6 R403Q/+突变的小鼠模型中评估泛KDM抑制剂JIB-04，观察疾病进展、心脏功能、纤维化及猝死，并结合RNA测序、ATAC-seq和蛋白质组学分析表观遗传机制，在人类HCM心脏和iPSC-CM中验证。
AI.result: JIB-04预防疾病进展，减少心肌肥厚和纤维化，保留心脏功能，完全预防环孢素A加速模型中的心源性猝死；逆转已建立疾病，停药后疗效持续，改善老年自发HCM小鼠心功能。RNA-seq和ATAC-seq显示部分恢复疾病相关转录程序和染色质可及性。蛋白质组学鉴定PHF2为JIB-04候选靶点，PHF2敲低抑制肥厚、炎症和纤维化基因表达。人类HCM心脏中多种JIB-04敏感KDM（包括PHF2）表达增加。在MYH7 R403Q iPSC-CM中，JIB-04使疾病相关基因表达正常化，恢复connexin-43膜定位，改善线粒体呼吸。长期治疗可致可逆性肝肿大和肝脏脂质积累，联用抗氧化剂N-乙酰半胱氨酸可减轻肝毒性而不影响疗效。
AI.conclusion: 药理抑制KDM通过表观遗传重塑预防和逆转HCM，PHF2是疾病发病的候选介质，KDM抑制是HCM有前景的治疗策略，支持进一步开发靶向KDM疗法；但需注意肝毒性风险，联合抗氧化剂可能减轻毒性。

summary_zh:
理由：肥厚型心肌病（HCM）是一种常见的遗传性心脏病，以心脏肥厚、纤维化、心律失常和心源性猝死（SCD）为特征。尽管目前的治疗主要针对肌节功能障碍，但表观遗传失调在HCM发病机制中的作用及其治疗潜力仍知之甚少。

目的：确定使用JIB-04对组蛋白赖氨酸去甲基化酶（KDM）进行药理抑制能否预防或逆转HCM进展，并确定潜在的的表观遗传机制。

方法与结果：我们在携带致病性人类MYH7 R403Q突变的小鼠同源突变Myh6 R403Q/+小鼠中评估了泛KDM抑制剂JIB-04。JIB-04阻止了疾病进展，减轻了心脏肥厚和纤维化，保留了心脏功能，并在环孢素A加速的HCM中完全预防了SCD。JIB-04还逆转了已建立的疾病，在停药后产生了持续的治疗益处，并改善了患有自发性HCM的老年小鼠的心脏功能。Bulk RNA测序和ATAC-seq显示疾病相关的转录程序和染色质可及性部分恢复。蛋白质组学分析确定PHF2（KDM7C）是JIB-04在小鼠和人类HCM心脏中的候选靶点。PHF2敲低分别抑制了心肌细胞、巨噬细胞和成纤维细胞中的肥厚、炎症和纤维化基因表达。人类HCM心脏表现出多种JIB-04敏感性KDM的表达增加，包括PHF2。在MYH7 R403Q诱导多能干细胞衍生的心肌细胞中，JIB-04使疾病相关基因表达正常化，恢复了连接蛋白43的膜定位，并改善了线粒体呼吸。尽管长期治疗诱导了可逆的肝肿大伴肝脏脂质积累，但联合使用抗氧化剂N-乙酰半胱氨酸减轻了肝毒性，同时保留了JIB-04的治疗功效。

结论：药理KDM抑制通过疾病相关转录和染色质程序的表观遗传重塑来预防和逆转HCM。这些发现确定KDM抑制是HCM的一种有前途的治疗策略，将PHF2确立为疾病发病机制的候选介质，并支持KDM靶向治疗的进一步开发。

title: Lead Exposure During Differentiation Perturbs Electrophysiological Function in iPSC-Derived Cardiomyocytes in a Cell Line-Dependent Manner
summary: Abstract Lead (Pb) exposure is strongly associated with cardiovascular diseases, but the effects of developmental Pb exposure on the electrophysiological properties of human cardiomyocytes have not yet been investigated. Using human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived cardiomyocytes, we investigated the effects of human-relevant Pb exposure during ventricular cardiomyocyte differentiation on action potential properties and calcium dynamics in differentiated myocytes. We exposed 2 iPSC lines, from 1 male and 1 female donor, to Pb (0.5 µM or 5 µM) or control during only the first 8 days of differentiation, prior to functional maturation. Differentiation was carried out using an established protocol involving temporal modulation of Wnt signaling, followed by purification and maturation of contractile myocytes. We measured action potential properties and calcium dynamics using fluorescent dyes and optical mapping. We hypothesized that Pb exposure would adversely affect cardiomyocyte function, with effects persisting after cessation of exposure. In keeping with this hypothesis, we found significant Pb-induced changes in calcium (Ca) transients and action potential dynamics that were concentration and cell line specific and persisted well after exposure had ended. In the female cell line, beat frequency significantly increased with Pb exposure for both action potentials and Ca transients, while in the male cell line, beat frequency significantly decreased with Pb exposure for action potentials and increased for Ca transients. For voltage measurements, we observed significantly increased arrythmias with Pb exposure in both cell lines. Significant changes in repolarization and recovery time (for voltage and Ca, respectively) were present with Pb exposure in both cell lines. Gene expression of Ca transporters/channels and K channels were not affected, suggesting that persistent effects of Pb exposure on cardiomyocyte electrophysiology may occur through post-translational mechanisms. Overall, this study paves the way for future work to examine how exposure to Pb impacts long-term cardiac function through developmental programming. title: The ARumenamide AR-788 suppresses the transient outward current in human iPSC-derived right-ventricular Brugada cardioids
summary: Abstract Brugada syndrome (BrS) is an inherited arrhythmia disorder with limited drug therapy, quinidine being the principal agent. Loss-of-function variants in SCN5A reduce the cardiac sodium current (INa), but the arrhythmogenic imbalance also depends on the transient outward potassium current (Ito). Here we generated human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardioids with right-ventricular identity from a patient carrying an SCN5A frameshift variant (p.A665Gfs*16) and characterised them by patch-clamp and optical mapping. BrS cardioids showed 60% lower peak INa, more than doubled Ito, 38% slower conduction and 76% longer spontaneous cycle length. We then tested AR-788, a benzylaminothiazole– benzimidazole carboxamide of the ARumenamide class. In wild-type (WT) cardiomyocytes AR-788 inhibited Ito concentration-dependently (12%, 30% and 42% at 5, 10 and 20 µM; extrapolated IC50 25.4 µM), and at 10 µM it returned BrS Ito to the level of untreated WT cells (21.71 vs 21.48 pA/pF, p = 0.9716) without reducing INa. It also reduced the rapid delayed-rectifier current (IKr) tail current by 40%, a liability requiring formal proarrhythmia profiling. These data identify AR-788 as an Ito-suppressing member of the ARumenamide class and provide proof of concept that a small molecule can correct the potassium-current excess in a human BrS model.

AI.tldr: AR-788在携带SCN5A移码突变的BrS右心室类器官中抑制Ito，使Ito恢复至野生型水平而不降低INa，但同时也抑制IKr。
AI.motivation: Brugada综合征（BrS）是遗传性心律失常，药物治疗选择有限，奎尼丁为主要药物。SCN5A功能缺失变异降低心脏钠电流（INa），但致心律失常的失衡也依赖于瞬时外向钾电流（Ito）。目前缺乏能纠正人类BrS模型中钾电流过度的小分子药物证据。
AI.method: 研究类型：基础实验研究。利用携带SCN5A移码变异（p.A665Gfs*16）的患者来源人诱导多能干细胞生成右心室身份的心脏类器官（cardioids），采用膜片钳和光学标测进行表征。测试ARumenamide类化合物AR-788（苯甲氨基噻唑-苯并咪唑甲酰胺）对Ito、INa和IKr的影响。主要终点为Ito电流密度变化，次要终点包括INa和IKr电流及传导参数。统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: BrS类器官显示峰值INa降低60%，Ito增加超过一倍，传导速度减慢38%，自发周期长度延长76%。在野生型心肌细胞中，AR-788浓度依赖性抑制Ito（5、10、20 µM时分别抑制12%、30%、42%；外推IC50为25.4 µM）。10 µM AR-788使BrS的Ito恢复至未处理野生型水平（21.71 vs 21.48 pA/pF，p=0.9716），且不降低INa。但AR-788使快速延迟整流钾电流（IKr）尾电流降低40%。
AI.conclusion: AR-788是ARumenamide类中抑制Ito的成员，并在人类BrS模型中提供小分子可纠正钾电流过度的小型概念验证。然而，其抑制IKr的倾向需要正式的前心律失常评估。该发现为BrS药物开发提供了新方向，但研究限于体外类器官模型，临床转化需进一步验证。
